A vacation to a wild west ghost town becomes more than Matlock bargained for as a bump on the head takes him straight back in time to the real old wild west, surrounded by familiar faces – with very unfamiliar occupations.
A friend of Matlock’s, Mike Wilson, has been murdered and his wife has been accused of the crime.
Ben Matlock investigates when a friend, Bobby Neil, is accused of murdering a cookie queen who was out to crumble her competitors with a hostile takeover.
A deathbed letter from an old friend puts the life of Ben Matlock in peril when he feels morally obligated to reopen a murder case more than three decades old.
Ben Matlock is convinced that Alex Gordon, a paraplegic, murdered his wife and framed his business partner, Bret Howell, for the crime.
Ben Matlock inherits a major problem when he agrees to defend Cliff Lockwood, an anti-social biker with an attitude the size of downtown Detroit.
Ignoring her father’s warnings, Leanne Mcintyre agrees to defend charismatic philanthropist Gil Stoddard, accused of brutally murdering his business partner.
It’s War of The Roses, Freudian style as divorcing psychiatrists forsake their couches for the courtroom. Matlock gets caught in the middle of a brutal battle that bruises more than egos.
Ben Matlock has an unusual problem defending a young married couple accused of murdering the woman who gave birth to a baby they were prepared to adopt.
Matlock’s on jury duty, and the case against a man-about-town who stands to gain a fortune from his wife’s death seems airtight. Close examination of the evidence suggests otherwise to Ben.

Matlock tries to defend hard-drinking country singer Jimmy Legrand after he’s arrested for the murder of his wife’s sister, but Legrand was so drunk on the night of the crime that he honestly can’t remember if he killed her.
When a successful country music star is murdered, the promoter she fired – Steve Fisher – becomes the logical suspect.

Family or not, Matlock regrets agreeing to hold a pre-wedding party for his bride-to-be goddaughter. Fights among the many freeloading guests have left his home in shambles and an old family feud has escalated into murder!

Matlock discovers he has more than enough suspects to go around for a murder which has the wrong man in jail.

A rare-coin dealer invests his trust in Matlock when he’s accused of murdering an employee who was caught stealing valuable coins. Meanwhile, Tyler becomes disgruntled when Matlock hires another private investigator, Linda Hansfield, to work on the case.

An undercover agent is murdered while trying to intercept a huge heroin shipment in the Pacific Northwest and the IMF team is called to take over and put the dealer and his chief executioner out of business.
Leonard Nimoy and guest star Dina Merrill join the Impossible Missions Force to fight a mind-destroying drug that could enslave the free world in the first of a two-part episode.

Jim Phelps lets himself be framed for murder in a scheme to discredit a scientist who has developed a mind-destroying drug in the second of a two-part episode on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."
Phelps and Mimi take on the guises of fugitives to invade the home of Jerome Cooper, a nuclear scientist, who is threatening to destroy a major American city with a fifty-megaton hydrogen bomb.
Christopher George guest stars in the role of a psychotic ex-convict determined to wreak vengeance on society.
Phelps poses as the head of a Hollywood movie studio as part of the IMF plan to prevent a crime syndicate's takeover of the studio.
Phelps poses as a murderer to infiltrate a gang that specializes in spiriting wanted men out of the country after first brainwashing them to learn the whereabouts of their vast sums of money.
Guest star Fernando Lamas portrays a diplomat-playboy who romances another diplomat's wife, played by Lee Grant.
Prince Iben Kostas plans to use his money to finance a war, the IMF team must stop him before it's too late.
William Shatner guest stars as an aging hoodlum who is artificially transplanted back to the 1930s and the scene of his unsolved crime.
In the country of Valeria, the IMF must assure that the corrupt Nationalist party's rigged voting machine doesn't give them the election.

Dean Stockwell guest stars as Gunnar Malstrom, one of the leaders of Pendulum --  a secret terrorist organization -- who has a plan involving a major attack on the government that the Impossible Missions Force is assigned to uncover.
Guest star Anne Francis joins the IMF when it sets out to prevent destruction of a secret formula vital to America's missile defense system on Paramount Television's "Mission: Impossible."
The Impossible Missions Force is asked to destroy an international narcotics ring operated by Alex Cresnic and his partner Mark Walters.

Before a statute of limitations expires on a 10-million dollar robbery, the Impossible Missions Force must spring the suspect from prison and dupe him into leading police to the hiding place of the money.

Phelps poses as an archeology professor and Dana as one of his graduate students, as the IMF goes to the aid of a group of young guerilla fighters in an effort to obtain from them a notebook containing vital scientific information in "The Rebel"

The Impossible Missions Force is pitted against the ingenious logic of an enemy agent (guest Steve Ihnat) as the IMF attempts to lead the agent through a maze of complicated clues in order to reach a false conclusion.

programmes.st: Queen Sara and Mayor Maggie Switch Jobs
programmes.d: Mister Rogers shows a video of children's television programs from around the world. Queen Sara Saturday and Mayor Maggie prepare for their job switch. Nancy Caterpillar is anxious to transition into being a butterfly.

programmes.st: Mister Rogers Talks About Alike and Different
programmes.d: Mister Rogers arrives with a dog. Bob Trow stops by with the Bob Dog costume. Prince Tuesday fears that the change will be permanent. Neighbor Aber arrives to explain that the switch is just temporary.

Mister Rogers arrives with a clown mask. "Mayor" Sara prepares a speech as two lost clowns arrive. To help the clowns find their way to the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Queen Sara suggests that she and Mayor Maggie trade jobs.

programmes.st: Circus Fun: Putting on Clown Make-Up
programmes.d: Nancy Caterpillar sees herself in a mirror and realizes that she is very special the way she is. She turns into a butterfly. Mister Rogers visits the circus and sees Jeff Gabel apply his clown make-up.

programmes.st: Memories of a Trip to Moscow
programmes.d: Mister Rogers shows pictures of the night and day skies. He plays with a star on a string and then remembers his trip to Moscow, where he met Russian children's television program producers. There is a  pretend star falling from a string.

Mister Rogers has some scuba diving equipment and imagines what a real scuba diver would see in the ocean. Some of the neighbors are frightened by Chuck Aber and Betty Okonak Templeton Jones in their scuba diving gear.

programmes.st: A Russian TV Host Visits Mister Rogers
programmes.d: Russian children's television host Tatiana Vedeneeva vists Mister Rogers and takes out a puppet from her program -- Stepashka, a very brave rabbit. In the Neighborhood, a visitor from the stars lands at the Museum-Go-Round.
Mister Rogers meets yo-yo expert Tom Parks and shows a film about nighttime workers. Daniel talks with Yo-Yo LaBelle, who is sad because he will have to leave the neighborhood at daybreak.

Mister McFeely delivers the wrong video tape. Mister Rogers reassures Mr. McFeely by singing You Are Special. King Friday is angry and belittles Miss Paulificate when she mistakenly delivers garden hoes instead of garden hose.

Mister Rogers and Eric Kloss visit a cavern led by Betty Aberlin. Inside the cavern, Mr. Kloss plays his saxophone while Mister Rogers plays an organ. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, King Friday hires a tutor for Prince Tuesday.
Marilyn Barnett stops by along with three students who demonstrate their jump roping skills. Lady Aberlin encourages Prince Tuesday to tell his father he wants to stay at Someplace Else School.

programmes.st: Being Kind to Ourselves and Others
programmes.d: In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, Broadway superstar Tommy Tune enchants the Neighbors with his dancing and his kindness.

Mister Rogers recalls when he was discouraged after someone told him he could not do something well. He kindly answers a phone call which turns out to be a wrong number. Sir Thomas Tune is  popular among the school children.

Riding their bicycles to the Scanlons' home, Mister Rogers and Mr. McFeely  discover that the house is built into the side of a hill. Mr. McFeely has a sand delivery that Mayor Maggie may have ordered for a secret project in Westwood.

Mister Rogers follows a scavenger hunt that leads to balloon artist, Bruce Franco. Lady Aberlin has a balloon and King Friday wonders what would happen if the air went out of it. Lady Aberlin encourages him to enjoy it and not worry.

Mister Rogers writes with invisible ink. Mr. McFeely delivers a heavy marble statue. Lady Elaine Fairchilde looks forward to her marriage to Neighbor Aber while Ana Platypus says that she is going to marry Daniel Striped Tiger.

programmes.st: Drawing a Picture with Closed Eyes
programmes.d: Mister Rogers tries to draw a picture with his eyes closed, but it doesn't turn out well. He visits Crist Delmonico, a blind artist who can visualize his artwork in his mind. King Friday announces that Queen Ida is coming to visit.
Mister Rogers deciphers an invisible ink note from Mr. McFeely and shows a video of how people make suitcases.

Mister Rogers enters wearing a reindeer hat complete with antlers. King Friday declares that everyone in the Neighborhood must wear at hat.   Andy Holiner and Alice Johnson sing  with some young friends.

programmes.st: It's fun when no one is left out
programmes.d: Mister Rogers arrives with a Randy S. Caribou figure made of clay. Then, visiting a nearby soccer field, Mister Rogres meets Dave Bartholomae, a coach who is holding practice with his young players.

programmes.st: Visit with a Special Olympics Team
programmes.d: Mister Rogers arrives with a basket from a Native American friend who keeps it near his door for friends to "put burdens here and come inside." Bob Dog invites King Friday to join their game, a first such invitation for the king.
Olympic gold medalist Suzie McConnell comes to give Mister Rogers a basketball lesson. In the Neighborhood of Make-Believe, everyone is welcomed to be part of a team and given team uniforms.
Mister Rogers and Mr. McFeely go bowling where they not only have a chance to bowl, but also to see how pins and balls are set up.

programmes.st: Enter the hot-blooded special forces! Battle on the bridge!
programmes.d: Luffy and his gang make a break for the docks, and Commander Jonathan deploys armed guards in an attempt to slow down the Straw Hats. Only one thing is certain: somebody is going down for the count!

programmes.st: Breaking through the seige! The going merry is recovered!

programmes.st: The gold and waver recovery operations!

programmes.st: Farewell, marine fortress! The last battle for escape!
programmes.d: The Straw Hats may think they’re in the clear, but Commander Jonathan has one final trap waiting to ground the Going Merry! If Luffy’s crew is to escape, they’ll need a helping hand – or eight!

programmes.st: Great adventure at long ring long land!
programmes.d: Luffy and his mates survive and near-death encounter with some mischievous sea monkeys only to land on a mysterious island where everything is much longer than it should be!

programmes.st: A davy back with the foxy pirates!
programmes.d: After a loyal horse and his recently-returned master are assaulted by thugs, Luffy is drawn into a Davy Back Fight with the Foxy Pirates. The Straw Hat captain never backs down from a challenge, but this contest could cost him his crew!

programmes.st: Round 1! One lap of the donut race!
programmes.d: The Davy Back Fight begins with a treacherous Donut Race around Ling Ring Long Land! The Straw Hats square off against the Foxy Pirates in a battle to see who loses a crew member!

programmes.st: Silver fox foxy! The merciless interference!
programmes.d: Nami uses her considerable skill as a navigator to put the Straw Hats on the verge of victory, but the captain of the Foxy Pirates has more than a few dirty tricks up his sleeve!

programmes.st: Round 2! Shoot it into the groggy ring!
programmes.d: Thanks to some foxy sabotage, Chopper has been lost to the enemy. The only hope for getting him back lies with Zoro and Sanji, but can they learn to work together in time to save the little reindeer?

programmes.st: A barrage of red cards in groggy ring!
programmes.d: Sanji and Zoro take a beating at the hands of the Groggy Monsters, but they won’t give up the fight. With a little luck – and some teamwork – they’ll emerge victorious from round two of the Davy Back Fight!
Round three of the Davy Back Fight is a rip roaring roller derby! Chopper’s fate still hangs in the balance, and the Straw Hats have a huge problem: Luffy doesn’t know how to skate!

programmes.st: A seriously heated race! Into the final round!
programmes.d: As the Davy Back Fight sprints toward a sensational finish, the Straw Hats find themselves on the brink of defeat! Luffy’s finally managed to stay on his skates, but the Foxy Pirates are notorious cheaters!
The Straw Hats somehow manage to defeat the Foxy Pirates and win back Chopper, but Luffy eagerly accepts the challenge of a rematch! What is the captain thinking? And will his crew mutiny?

programmes.st: Showdown on the cliff! Red light, green light!

programmes.st: The captains square off! The final combat round!

programmes.st: Full-blast slow-slow onslaught vs. Invulnerable luffy
programmes.d: Luffy and Captain Foxy go toe-to-toe in a brutal battle waged aboard a booby-trapped boat. Luffy is fighting for his crew, but Captain Foxy’s dirty tricks have him on the ropes!

programmes.st: Epic, heated combat! The fateful final conclusion

programmes.st: Was it lost? Stolen? Who are you?

programmes.st: A mysterious boy with a horn and robin's deduction!
programmes.d: Robin tries to hold the crew together while unraveling the mystery of the missing memories. Meanwhile, Nami and Zoro flashback to painful moments from their pasts.

programmes.st: Now, let's get back our memories! The pirate crew lands on the island!

programmes.st: Zoro bares his fangs! A savage animal stands in the way!

programmes.st: The last counterattack by the memory thief who reveals his true colors!
programmes.d: The Straw Hats finally regain their memories, but a much larger challenge looms on the horizon. The mysterious thief is about to transform into something even more powerful!

programmes.st: The guy who's the closest to invincible? And the most dangerous man!
programmes.d: Luffy and his mates must survive another outrageous battle aboard Captain Foxy’s booby-trapped boat, and even if they survive, something far worse awaits them!

programmes.st: Navy headquarters admiral aokiji! The ferocity of an ultimate powerhouse!
programmes.d: The Straw Hats take time out to help a group of hungry castaways, but trouble looms on the horizon. An icy marine adversary is out to track down Robin!

programmes.st: Duel between rubber and ice! Luffy vs. Aokiji!
programmes.d: Chopper and Usopp work feverishly to save Robin from her icy tomb, and Luffy looks to settle the score with Admiral Aokiji in a man-to-man fight to the finish!

programmes.st: The dashing sea train and the city of water, water seven!
programmes.d: An encounter with a giant swimming frog leads to a close call with a seafaring train! Next up for the Straw Hats: drop anchor at a town full of water and seek out a shipwright!

programmes.st: Adventure in the city on the water! Head to the mammoth shipbuilding plant!
programmes.d: Luffy, Usopp, and Nami take a wild ride through Water Seven in search of a shipwright. Meanwhile, Chopper and Robin get separated during their quest to find a bookstore!
Zoro is attacked by thugs who want to cash in on his bounty, Sanji gets lost on a grocery shopping expedition, and three suitcases full of cash mysteriously go missing!

programmes.st: Galley-la company! A grand sight: dock #1!

The Pickers visit Tom whose amazing collection of architectural salvage includes a vintage theater marquee and rare opera house relics.
Burning up the back roads of South Dakota, Mike and Frank get off to a great start in Jim's spectacular man-cave. But when he slams on the brakes.
In Mississippi, Mike and Frank find what turns out to be a priceless, 65-million year-old dinosaur bone. It's appraised by the curator of the Mississippi Museum of Natural Science.
In an antique shop closed since the 70s, Mike and Frank go toe-to-toe with the sibling owners who negotiate for every last dollar.

The Pawn Stars look to buy a 1929 Chopped Ford Coupe but if they can't agree on a price, will the deal end up rusting in the bone yard? Then, a cowboy wants to sell his mechanical calf-roping machine.
The Pawn Stars have an opportunity to buy something they've never bought before--a helicopter! Can Rick convince the Old Man to come along and spin up a deal?
The Pawn Stars are presented with one of most unique items to ever hobble its way into the shop--a pirate's peg leg.

The Pawn Stars snap to attention when an 1830's percussion musket from West Point marches into the shop. One of only a couple hundred ever made, will this rare cadet training weapon pass inspection, or will it end up with a demerit?
The Pawn Stars are on hallowed ground when a piece of marble from Abraham Lincoln's tomb enters the shop.
The Pawn Stars are brushed with Vegas royalty when they are presented with a huge truckload of personal tapes.
Tammie and Johnnie try to lasso a deal on an antique toy horse, and a customer walks in with a very rare weapon.

programmes.t: Cajun Pawn Stars: The King and His Crown

Johnnie and Tammy attempt to strike a deal on a 1971 Fender Precision Bass guitar that will leave Jimmie speechless.

programmes.t: Cajun Pawn Stars: Jimmie's Increasingly Bad Day
programmes.d: It's father vs. daughter when Tammie bets her dad that she can brighten his day and make a profit on a unique bar-on-wheels.
Jimmie challenges the team to get to work on time, and the last one to arrive has to take care of all four of the shop dogs for an entire day.
A motorized Coca-Cola mini car, a rare collection of World War II Japanese tank items and a treasured prop from "Dances With Wolves" are all on the counter.

Looking for picks in Texas, the guys see a sign for Gilley's Club, the honky-tonk club made famous in the 1980 film Urban Cowboy. Soon they're face to face with country music superstar Mickey Gilley himself.

Cruising along the California coastline, the guys know they're in for something big. Mil Blair founded the iconic motorcycle magazine Easyriders and, for the first time ever, the legend is willing to sell some of his rare collections of motorbikes.

In Florida, Mike and Frank visit a hangar-sized barn full of treasures, owned by a couple of junkyard junkies who've been picking since 1948. An awesome circus property turned animal preserve features lions, tigers, and bears.

While cruising through South Carolina, looking for leads, the guys call an old picking contact and soon find themselves in Bill's main street hardware store. The family business has been operating since the 1880s.
Looking for roadside relics in West Virginia, the guys pick an Appalachian village museum where Mike ups the ante to score a rare retro motor. The museum's octogenarian owners.

In upstate New York, the guys stop in at a sprawling treasure-laden farm with fourteen jam-packed trailers, the result of a lifetime of collecting by the late owner. His daughter needs to sell some of his things to help save the farm.
This sexy sequel to EL MARIACHI follows a mysterious guitar player (Antonio Banderas) as he seeks vengeance against the men who murdered his girlfriend.
Zoe Saldaña plays a young woman out to get revenge on the mobster responsible for her parents' deaths. Produced by Luc Besson and Ariel Zeitoun.

When his mentor, Admiral James Greer, becomes ill, Ryan is appointed acting CIA Director of Intelligence.
East-West tensions erupt when the CIA suspects that renegade Russian scientists are developing more nuclear weapons.
Jack Ryan must quickly evolve from soldier to analyst to full-fledged operative to stop a devastating terrorist plot against the United States.

While searching for a philanthropist’s missing wife, the team comes up against a grifter ring running a web of sophisticated “Sweetheart Scams”.
The Leverage team hits the recession-driven Cash-for-Gold industry by targeting a corrupt brother-sister team and steering them through an elaborate treasure hunt.
When Latimer hires Nate's father to pull off a heist in an ultra-secure government office, the Leverage team must stage a fake hostage stand-off…
The LEVERAGE team must recruit old friends and rivals to take down Latimer and a foe from their past.

While trying to save a stubborn hockey enforcer from sustaining a permanent injury in the playoffs, Leverage discovers that someone has nefarious designs on the team.
The Leverage team takes down a wealthy scientist who stole his former research partner's discovery and ruined his reputation by convincing him he's made first contact with aliens.

After Rina is critically wounded while heading to work with Jubal; the team makes the chilling discovery that a vengeful Vargas orchestrated the shooting from behind bars and continues to target the rest of their team and their loved ones.
As the team investigates a string of jewelry store robberies that culminate in a double murder,they uncover a connection to a 16-year-old boy trying to survive the foster care system.
As the team searches for an abducted college co-ed,Jubal becomes intent on obtaining lifesaving leads from the father of the abductor's previous victim.
Maggie goes undercover working in a bar to investigate an anti-government group that regularly gathers there and has several members suspected in a series of bombings.
When a Muslim college student and his younger brother are murdered, the team connects with the outraged imam of OA's former mosque, who insists the victims were wrongly targeted as terrorists.
The team rushes to investigate an extremist gun group after an anti-gun lobbyist building is bombed, with the promise of others to follow.

A shocking twist in the murder investigation brings Layton and Till's manhunt to a cat-and-mouse climax, but Layton is getting too close to Melanie's big secret, which may prove the most dangerous game of all.
While Jenkins discovers there's something wrong with the Library since it returned from the Void, the Librarians all find themselves drawn back together.
The Clipping Book sends the team to a high-tech research facility, where the researchers have been turned into mindless monsters by some bizarre power source in the center's lab.

Students start disappearing at Wexler College, an institution started by a mad historian/architect who believed in alternate dimensions.

Bellamy (BOB MORLEY) leads the charge investigating a potential way home.  Meanwhile, Clarke and Madi (LOLA FLANERY) deal with the new uncertain threat to their home.

Kane's attempt to prove himself useful tests Wonkru's allegiance to Octavia. Madi faces an unexpected threat inside Wonkru, forcing Clarke to make an unlikely ally.
Clarke and Bellamy make a startling discovery about Wonkru's battle plans as Echo (TASYA TELES) risks her friendship with Raven (LINDSEY MORGAN) to complete her mission.
Clarke's determination to protect Madi puts Bellamy in an impossible situation.

Laurel represents Oliver when he is arrested by her father for murder. Subjugated to a polygraph test, Oliver recalls his struggles against Deathstroke on the island.
When the Royal Flush Gang robs a local bank, Diggle suggests that Oliver deviates from his father's list and helps the citizens of Starling City.
Oliver encounters a mysterious woman, Helena Bertinelli (Jessica DeGouw), with whom he can finally be himself, but soon comes to realize she's hiding dangerous secrets of her own.

The boys head to Iceland in search of the Atlantic Wolfish. These terrifying-looking, deep-sea monsters are the ultimate anti-heroes, keeping the entire marine ecosystem from collapsing.
The Fishing Impossible team are in the wilds of Zambia, Africa to go head to head in a no holds barred competition to catch the legendary Tigerfish.

Faced with eighty metre high cliffs and some of the roughest waters in the world, the team will have to put their bodies on the line and overcome their deepest fears if they are to succeed in their expedition.
The boys travel to Nepal in search of Charlie's dream fish, the Golden Mahseer. Able to detect imminent avalanches and earthquakes, Mahseer have extremely highly developed senses.
The Fishing Impossible team head to Mozambique to take on the world's ultimate spear fishing challenge. Their mission is to spear a powerful dogtooth tuna at St Lazarus Banks.

The Fishing Impossible team are on the trail of one of the most elegant apex predators in the ocean, the beautiful Blue Shark. The mission takes the boys to the unlikeliest of locations, Cornwall - south west of the UK.

Jay, Blowfish and Charlie's mission takes them to Kenya in search of Africa's largest freshwater fish, the Nile Perch. To catch it they'll endure a 500 kilometre bone-shaking drive across some of Kenya's toughest terrain.
Every autumn millions of salmon run up the rivers of British Columbia to spawn. But after months of drought the guys are forced to venture deep into the mountains to find the fish.
Native to the Indo-Pacific but accidentally introduced to the Caribbean, Lionfish are decimating the island ecosystems.

Freediver and spear-fisherman Jay wants the boys to join him in taking on a mighty Giant Moray Eel. They seek out the help of world renowned freedivers, the nomadic Sea Gypsies, to learn how to take on these seas, and these huge fish.

In this episode the team's mission takes them to the barren icy mountains of Patagonia, in search of a deep-sea delicacy. The Patagonian Toothfish sells for $100 per kilo in the fish markets of North America.
Claudia pulls out all the stops to try and make a big sale to jade buyers, while up at the mine Guy and Gary struggle through the first snowstorm of the season.
Claudia pushes her crew to keep mining despite freezing temperatures and deteriorating road conditions, but her biggest obstacle could be Robin who wants to pack up before it's too late.
Claudia's season starts off with a bang when she receives a $250,000 jade order, but things quickly turn sour when her crew questions if they have a big enough boulder to complete the sale.
After years of getting the raw end of the deal with Scrappy Larry, Robin pulls a prank on his old buddy, but the fun and games end when Claudia's buyer makes an unexpected request.
Under pressure to meet their buyer's tight deadline, Robin and Josh clash when they run into endless problems setting up the wire saw.
When a major breakdown threatens to shut down the mine, Claudia and Robin make a risky decision to get desperately needed fuel into camp.
Josh narrowly avoids disaster driving into the mine with a load of fuel and Claudia's devastated when a jade slab cracks in half while she's running the saw.
Cari, a young mother living in California, is brutally stabbed, beaten, and sexually assaulted by an intruder in her home, but knows she must survive the attack to save her son.

Three masked gunmen burst into Michelle's home, then tape dynamite to the bodies of the bank executive and her 7-year-old daughter, and order her to rob the bank vault where she works or they'll blow up her little girl.
Maria feared for her safety as one of her fellow employees at the hospital where she worked became increasingly volatile.

It's a brand new start for the Operation Repo team when Lou bets big on a high-risk opportunity and sets up shop in Las Vegas! But first, Ronnie and Froy must wrangle a wrestling ring from a Lucha Libre school.

The team is ahead of schedule on their Vegas mission, but will it all be derailed when Froy brings unwanted trouble back to the office? Also, Ronnie and Froy run into an unexpected dilemma when a husband's better halves take the reins.

An Elvis impersonator gets Matt and Ronnie all shook up, and a ventriloquist's dummy has a nasty attitude that gets on Sonia's bad side. When Froy goes missing, Lou has to pick up the slack in a repo that goes terribly wrong.

Fuming over Froy's departure, Matt loses his temper on a dominatrix and her client and packs his bags to return to LA.? Down two repo men, the pressure is on Ronnie and Carlos, who interrupts a couple in the middle of their less-than-holy matrimony.

The team returns from a successful mission in Vegas, but there's trouble brewing within the crew's ranks. Ronnie and Carlos repo from a self-defense instructor who lets his students do his dirty work.

Matt and Froy struggle with language barriers when an Italian photographer and his assistant resort to violence because they can't comprehend. Will Sonia finally reveal what's happening, or will carrying her brother's burden get the best of her?

The team wonders what's up with Sonia as she wrestles with Lou's big secret. Ronnie goes undercover and takes a gold-digging RO out on a date, but when Carlos lets the cat out of the bag all hell breaks loose.

Lou has retired, making Sonia the new boss, but will she be able to keep the company going without her big brother? Matt and Ronnie try to take a car away from a yuppie with an unusual taste for red meat.

Sonia pushes the company to repossess more than just cars, and the backlash from the team threatens to end her time in charge before it's even begun. Ronnie and Matt attempt to repo from a reckless motocross daredevil.

Sonia, the new boss, is still struggling to keep the team in line, but when tragedy strikes on a routine repossession, her reign at the top faces its biggest challenge yet. Matt and Froy hit the club to take a sports car away from a deadbeat DJ.
Carlos goes undercover at a frat house, but when the party gets the best of him Sonia has to step in and fight the drunken mob. Matt and Ronnie go after some wanna-be internet sensations.
Matt is eager to work his way onto Sonia's coveted airplane repo, despite her adamancy against him.
After losing 70lbs, Detroit ticketer Robert is extra confident when challenged by an outraged man who parked commercial equipment on the street.
Sparks fly as Mike stumbles onto a parking fiasco at a Philly gala event. Rodney and Michele catch red-handed a Detroiter in the act of removing a boot.
A hit and run throws Detroit booters Courtney and Sonjia off their beat.
Philadelphia ticket writer Jeff returns to Parking Wars, this time as a newly promoted supervisor. When tempers flare on South Street on Saturday night, he runs to the rescue of his new squad.

Danielle, who has a reputation for attracting trouble while ticketing, gets into a shouting match during her "rush hour sting." At the impound lot, Rob has a run-in with an angry lady over the paperwork required to get her car back.

Booters Steve and Sherry go on the hunt when a booted vehicle goes missing, while best friends Brian and Lori shake it up on their ticketing beat. At the lot, a World War II veteran does battle for his impounded truck.
At the lot, John scrambles to find the impounded car of a woman whose taxi meter is ticking. Meanwhile, Tiffany, nicknamed "swoop" for her killer ticketing instincts, shows off her techniques.
Yolanda has her hands full trying to help the owner of a tricked-out pink truck through the red tape to get it released. Tow truck driver John faces a car owner who tries to lock him out.

Mark redirects the crew to focus their efforts on a 1969 Superbee the owner has been patient but is eagerly awaiting delivery and Mark doesn't want Christine or any other project to delay this classic muscle car build.
With final assembly finished the 1970 Rallye Red 'Cuda is ready to be fired up and driven before its maiden voyage the crew takes a look back at this car's journey of restoration.
One of eight ever made the 1971 In Violet Plymouth 'Cuda 383 is finished and ready for delivery the crew reflects on the journey the car has taken before the final touches are put on.

In a build too big for just one episode the tribute 1958 Plymouth Fury famously known as Christine not only gets a full restoration with OE attention to detail but it also gets a brand-new modern third-generation engine.

With the SEMA Show 2019 just days away the team scrambles to finish the assembly of the tribute "Christine." Mark begins to question how complete the car will be when it ships to the convention center in Las Vegas Nevada.
Danny checks out a mind-blowing collection, which includes a 1933 Ford Roadster and a '53 Henry J. Meanwhile Kevin, Ryan and Mike make.
A returning customer needs Danny's help restoring a 1971 Road Runner to give as a commemorative gift to his wife and step-daughter.

programmes.d: The night sky has always been a source of wonder and mystery. In the quest to explore the universe, our greatest ally is the Hubble telescope.
When the universe formed, all of space blazed white-hot, but it didn't last. Darkness reined for 200 million years before the light was reborn.
Color is essential to both art and astronomy. When measured, it can tell us the temperature, chemical composition, and motion of astronomical objects.
For most of human history, the night sky seemed two-dimensional. To our ancestors, this perspective gave no hint to the universe's true depth.

Hurricanes, Typhoons and Cyclones all the same thing with different names – what they also have in common is their destructive power! Hurricanes are large, swirling storms and winds from a hurricane can damage buildings or trees.

A vivacious young entertainer on a high-end luxury cruise draws so many admirers, jealousies start to flare. After a night of socializing, she doesn't show up for rehearsal. What really happened behind her locked cabin door?

A therapist known for her loving attitude goes on a cruise with her husband as they attempt to repair their strained marriage. Unfortunately, their week alone comes to a tragic end as her body falls from an upper deck.

How do bugs, pigs, and even the weather help investigators solve crimes? From tropical Hawaii to the frigid waters of Lake Ontario, forensic experts reveal, in gory detail, the clues nature leaves behind on a human corpse.

Can the sound of a suspect’s voice reveal his lie? Can the crucial moment of a crime be revealed? Can computers isolate a guilty face in a crowd? No longer science fiction, these are the high-tech tools of the forensics trade.

Fire, water, and earth – killers call on all the elements in their attempt to cover up their crimes. But even a body burned to ashes, sunk deep into the sea, or reduced to fragments will still tell its forensic tale.

Criminals are betrayed by the clues their own bodies leave behind. A killer’s ear against a wall, a hand on a door, the path that he walks – even the slightest impressions left at the scene helps crime fighters find their man.

Episode 8 includes The Miracle That Is Beavis, Impotence, Inventors, and Canned.
Episode 9 includes Drinking Butt-ies, Garage Band, Die Fly, Die!, and Breakdown.
Episode 10 includes Speech Therapy, Work Is Death, Graduation Day and Butt Flambé.
Episode 11 includes Leave It To Beavis, and Beavis and Butt-Head Are Dead.
Noah really gets into his Halloween costume, and white zombies attack.
Luther informs Mitt Romney who won the election, and a non-stop party refuses to stop.
Two gang rivals get inside each other's heads, and a police officer hones his act.
A tough guy cries in front of his crew, and substitute teacher Mr. Nostrand does not play.

programmes.st: Chappelle's Show Oprah's Baby Daddy & Jury Duty
programmes.d: Dave gets Oprah pregnant and recalls being a member of the O.J. Simpson trial jury.
When a government-chartered Learjet crashes into Mexico City, drug cartels are suspected, but there's more to the story.
A foggy morning in Milan turns deadly when an MD-87, leaving Italy's Linate Airport, collides with a Cessna crossing the same runway.
Follow the investigation of the controversial crash of an El Al 747 into a high-rise Amsterdam apartment complex.
A sweeping journey over America's western landscape, featuring stories of colorful characters and "wild" history.
Join us on a coast-to-coast tour of countless locations made famous by Hollywood's greatest films.
Discover Michigan's diverse history and its visionaries who built empires, started unions, and helped win a World War.
See Rhode Island from the sky and witness the East Coast's tiny gleaming treasure.
Colorado is a state with a history, marked by war, a gold rush, and legendary bank robberies. Through it all, Colorado remains a feast for the eyes.
Oregon: From Crater Lake to the High Cascades to the perilous Pacific coastline, this state is full of natural beauty.
In 1942, a secret British regiment led a daring raid on a Nazi-occupied Libyan harbor.
Easy Company's mission to take out German howitzers hours before the D-Day invasion.
The history of the B-1 Lancer reveals how the Cold War bomber evolved to become one of America's most effective military aircraft.
An inside look at the brief but historic service of the Grumman F6F Hellcat and its instrumental role in winning the Pacific War.
The history and evolution of America's most legendary spy plane.
The inside story of the U.S. military's go-to fighter for over four decades: the F-4 Phantom
An inside look at the world's first dedicated armed attack helicopter, the Cobra, and its most thrilling missions in Vietnam, Grenada, and Iraq.

November 2003, brothers Justin and Jeremy Harris go canyoneering in Utah's Canyons. They expect the trip will take no more than eight hours, but when freezing temperatures come by, Justin breaks his leg and Jeremy has to hike out to find help.

In April 1999, three British climbers get caught in a snowstorm near the summit of Mt. McKinley. After a night in a cave, one climber develops snow blindness and another volunteer to go down to base camp but breaks both his legs in a fall.
Michigan conservation officers patrol snowmobilers in the northern Lower Peninsula and officers in mid-Michigan check out "Tip Up Town" where ice fishing activity ramps up.
Deer patrols on the firearm opener as well as later in the season by Michigan conservation officers.

Michigan conservation officers contact observe salmon anglers during the busy fall salmon spawning run. Also, segments on the Gladwin Field Trial Area and officers lend a hand in getting toys to underpriveleged children for Christmas.

Michigan conservation officers in districts 1 and 5 check out snowmobilers and ice anglers. Also, a look into trying to get an accurate moose count from a plane and conservation officers who help to gather toys for children for Christmas.
Michigan Conservation Officers patrol salmon fishermen, another CO shares his turkey hunting expertise with a hunter safety class, and a look into the DNR's efforts to place bands onto geese.

Two Michigan conservation officers in the southern part of the state investigate a case of deer carcasses they found near some railroad tracks. Also, a look at an opportunity for veterans and first responders to hunt pheasants.
Two Michigan conservation officers, one in the southwest part of the state and the other in the northeast, check on waterfowl hunters. One of them also investigates illegal bear baits.

One Michigan conservation officer checks on waterfowl hunters while another observes salmon anglers during the busy fall spawning run.  Also, the state works to move a historical building away from a receding lakeshore.

Michigan conservation officers check on ice anglers and snowmobilers in both the Lower and Upper Peninsula. The state also teams up with with local musicians to create a sound track that includes sounds from nature.

Michigan conservation officers patrol on the opening day of firearm deer season as well as later in deer season.  Officers also team up to raise money to help their fellow officers and their families by playing hockey.
Michigan conservation officers play a pivotal role during this migration season. As the birds sweep across the state, officers are vigilant sentinels, safeguarding their passage.
Michigan conservation officers in the middle part of the state team up to run patrols in both the fall and the winter for deer season as well as snowmobiling and ice fishing seasons.

In June 2003, Blake Stanfield and his aged dad Neil go kayaking in the Alaskan wilderness. Everything goes fine until they run into some ice on the river, and they soon find themselves swept underneath.

In August 2002, a young man and woman, once dating, headed for the Amazon rain forest but got lost in the jungle. They have to survive the dangers of the jungle and hold on to their sanity as they find their way home.

In April 2004, Arthur Taylor, Alistair Gellatly, Arthur's wife Fay and parents Clive and Brenda become stranded in the hippo and crocodile-infested Zambezi River when their watercraft is rammed by a mad hippo and sinks.
In March 2002, when filming for a documentary they were making, 2 divers Melissa Armstrong and Captain David Tomlinson became stranded in the Pacific Ocean when their boat drifts away from them.
In June 1996, a group of 5 teenage scouts and 3 adult guides hiked into the Grand Canyon during a heatwave; the route was an off-trail route in the vicinity of the Nankoweap Trail.
The end of Montana's long winter is finally in sight. Tom and Nancy Oar are scrambling to get through the last of their winter works when a surprise call comes in from family.
Winter has finally come to a close, spelling big changes for Tom, who bids farewell to an old friend and packs his bags for Florida.
Everyday is a fight for their freedom and independence, but some battles are harder fought and push the men closer to the edge than ever before.
This season opens as a polar vortex sweeps across the nation and plunges America into a brutal early winter.
Jennifer picks up a small racing boat in California and has a series of bad experiences that brings her to tears before she even crosses the state line.
Chris and Robbie play Robin Hood when delivering some faulty children's toys back to the manufacturer.
Jarrett questions his ability to ship a very rare electric sports car cross country alongside a precariously-placed hunk of metal.
Chris and Robbie win a creepy load of horror memorabilia but the real scare comes when the cargo is twice as big as they agreed on.
Jarrett sinks to a new low in his negotiating skills when he fails to deliver a trailer-load of surfboards on time and the customer demands a discount.
Roy cracks a smile during a ride on a submersible boat he ships, but the grin turns to a grimace when the boat threatens to blow-up his trailer en route.
Team Salvage is tasked with removing a broken down tractor from a Caravan Park in trouble with the law and Luke responds to an unlucky boat owner in desperate need of help.

Extreme Salvage Squad is off on a wild frontier adventure into Arnhem Land in the Northern Territory with a new look team and an awesome line-up of noisy gear to tackle the biggest salvage jobs of their careers.

Ton and Allen go North to Alaska and get a cold reception from the local auctioneer. They find two enormous seaplane pontoons and a pair of Smith & Wesson revolvers, including the most powerful production handgun in the world!

Ton and Allen get a surprise second chance after nearly getting shut out in the small town of Palmer.  They uncover a motorized railroad maintenance car from the 1960s and a pre-WWI Japanese semi-automatic pistol.

Ton & Allen face some silent but deadly competition at an auction in nearby Glendale. They discover a Zildjian brand percussion cymbal from the 1940s and a pyrotechnics control board designed for large-scale fireworks displays!

Allen & Ton head to New Orleans in search of easy money, but instead encounter some bayou bidders with big-time bucks! They discover a pair of early 19th-century dueling pistols & a vintage airboat fitted with a turbine engine!
Tempers flare and prices soar as the buyers confront aggressive guest auctioneer Jeff Schwartz, aka “The Liquidator.”
Guest auctioneer Patrick Pecker brings “the full Pecker” to the auction, fuelling his longstanding feud with Roy.
Roy suits up in full army gear to declare war on the buyers in Scarborough.
Roy’s paltry gifts are no match for Cindy’s foul mood at the auction in Scarborough.

programmes.st: The Seven Habits of Highly Effective Instigators
programmes.d: The Thornhill buyers run for cover when a self-help CD gives Roy a new lease on his egomaniacal life.
A Brampton auction near some of the gang’s old high school proves they’re all still rowdy teenagers at heart.
Paul’s locker addiction reaches new highs (and lows) at the Wasaga Beach auction.
Rick and Cindy bring a psychic to help them land the best lockers in Don Mills.
Team Salvage is on a back-to-back muddy monster machine SOS in the Northern Territory.
Team Salvage is on an environmental clean-up mission to remove a toxic rotting vessel that’s trapped on a beach in the Northern Territory.
While prepping for a diver to explore the bottom of 10-X, Rick and Marty Lagina arrange to send an ROV camera down the shaft, which reveals evidence that could threaten their entire operation.
Rick Lagina, Jack Begley and Dave Blankenship are looking for the missing H.O. stone a mysterious carved stone that was part of a larger boulder on the north shore.
Rick and Marty Lagina make an exciting discovery after forging a truce with Dan Blankenship's longtime rival, Fred Nola.
While back in Michigan on business, Marty Lagina, his son Alex and Craig Tester meet with divers and side scan sonar experts.
The Enterprise must decide on its response when a Romulan ship makes a destructively hostile armed probe of Federation territory.
A U.S.S. Enterprise landing party beams down to an uncharted planet. The planet seems like a perfect candidate for shore leave with its "Earth-type" characteristics.
Spock commands a stranded away team when their shuttlecraft is stranded on a planet with hostile natives.
A powerful entity known as Trelane torments the crew of the Enterprise.
The U.S.S. Enterprise is in pursuit of an unknown alien ship which has destroyed a Starfleet base.
The U.S.S. Enterprise is thrown into a time warp and ends up orbiting Earth in the 20th century.
Captain Kirk's career is at stake when he is put on trial for the loss of a crewman during an ion storm.
The Enterprise encounters a seemingly peaceful civilization run by a "benevolent" being named Landru...who intends for them to join his people.
Kirk meets Khan, a notorious dictator, and leader of Earth's Eugenics War.
The Enterprise arrives at a planet to establish diplomatic relations and finds itself in the middle of a "peaceful" war that threatens to destroy the ship.
The Enterprise visits a colony where indigenous flower spores provide the settlers with peaceful contentment.
The Enterprise is sent to a mining colony that is being terrorized by a mysterious monster, only to find that the situation is not that simple.
With a war raging, Kirk and Spock battle Klingons to free Organia.
Kirk and Spock encounter a mysterious alien named Lazarus who claims to be hunting a ruthless maniacal creature.

programmes.st: The City On The Edge Of Forever
programmes.d: Kirk and Spock go back in time to save McCoy from temporary insanity.
Kirk and the U.S.S. Enterprise must combat parasitic aliens.
Spock must return to Vulcan to meet his intended future wife, betrothed from childhood.
Worf's plans for a traditional Klingon wedding are threatened when Martok's wife refuses to accept Dax into their family.
The alternate universe double of Kira's slain love requests asylum on Deep Space Nine.
Genetically engineered savants under Bashir's supervision predict doom for the Federation.
Quark leads a Ferengi mission to rescue his mother from the Dominion.
After their ship is destroyed, Sisko is stranded on a distant planet with an increasingly disturbed Dukat.
Quark inherits a fortune -and a group of thieves lay claims to the estate.
Hidden on a shrunken Runabout, Dax, O'Brien, and Bashir are Sisko's only hope when the Jem'Hadar overtake the Defiant.
Sisko envisions he is a science-fiction writer encountering racism in 1953 America.
An undercover operation turns personal for O'Brien when he befriends his criminal contact.
When Dax is seriously injured during a crucial mission, Worf must question his priorities.

programmes.st: Wrongs Darker Than Death or Night
programmes.d: Kira learns that her mother was once Gul Dukat's mistress.
An internal investigation indicates Doctor Bashir may be a Dominion spy.
Sisko attempts to trick the Romulans into declaring war against the Dominion.
Odo receives lessons in romancing Kira from a holographic 1960's lounge singer.
Sisko must risk his son's life to fulfill his role as the Emissary.
Jake and Nog are rescued by an elite group of Starfleet cadets on a secret mission.
When Grand Nagus Zek is deposed, Quark poses as a female to help him regain his power.
Six years in the future, an emotional Captain Archer and the crew return to Earth to face the decommission of Enterprise and signing of the Federation charter.

The maiden crew of the starship Enterprise seizes the long overdue opportunity to gain independence for Humans from the Vulcans by venturing into untracked space to deliver a Klingon messenger to his home world of Kronos.

The maiden crew of the starship Enterprise seizes the long overdue opportunity to gain independence for Humans from the Vulcans by venturing into untracked space to deliver a Klingon messenger to his home world of Kronos.

Archer must choose between the safety of his crew and doing the right thing as the vulnerable Enterprise must survive while trying to uphold justice between two different unknown alien ships in battle.

An Enterprise away-team fights delusions and paranoid suspicions caused by an alien wildflower's hallucinogenic pollen while stranded overnight to wait out a violent windstorm on a beautiful unexplored planet.
While attempting to repair the warp engine of an alien ship, Trip inadvertently becomes impregnated and the Enterprise must relocate the ship before the baby is due.

The first to see the lost human colony of Terra Nova in over seventy-five years, Archer and the Enterprise crew discover the original colonists descendants have evolved into an underground race called Novans.

Archer, Trip and T'Pol make first contact with the suspicious and militaristic Andorians while helping to reveal the secrets within the ancient Vulcan monastery of P'Jem, uncovering a major violation of the Andorian/Vulcan Peace Treaty
Archer attempts a little diplomacy with a very unwelcoming Vulcan Captain. Reed and Mayweather are in danger while drilling for samples on an uncharted massive comet.
Discovering their first alien civilization, Archer and the crew unfortunately also find a ship of invasive alien miners who are carelessly causing thousands of innocent deaths upon the planet.

In attempting to aid the damaged Earth freighter Fortunate, the Enterprise finds itself caught in the middle of a cold-blooded revenge plot. Mayweather uses his past to ultimately resolve the heated conflict

While the Enterprise witnesses a religious stellar occurrence, Archer finds himself again faced against the Suliban warrior Silik, while allied with a Temporal soldier from the future sent to prevent Silik from changing the course of history.
Faced with defending themselves against a powerful, unidentified alien vessel, Trip and Reed frantically work to install the massive phase cannons into the Enterprise before the vessel returns.

After discovering that an alien race is slowly becoming extinct due to a genetic disease, Archer and Dr. Phlox struggle with the decision of whether to interfere by saving the species or to let nature make its own choices.
While investigating a strange Klingon vessel, T'Pol, Reed and Hoshi become stranded when a Klingon female escapes the disabled ship in their shuttlepod.
T'Pol is blamed for the Andorian destruction of the sanctuary of P'Jem, and is therefore removed of her position onboard the Enterprise.

After returning to where they left the Enterprise and finding only the scattered remains of their ship, Trip and Reed struggle to survive and hope for rescue with only a few days worth of oxygen left inside Shuttlepod One.
While suffering an unexplained case of amnesia, the crew finds themselves fighting a war they do not remember or understand.
Inhabited by alien spirits, Data and Troi overthrow the Bridge of the Enterprise.
Loyalty and ethics clash when a paralyzed Worf asks to help him commit suicide.
A rescue mission leads to a dangerous romance between Riker and a rebellious member of an androgynous race.
The Enterprise is trapped in a time warp that forces the crew to endlessly repeat the same experiences.
Caught between loyalty to his friends and the need to tell the truth, Wesley becomes involved in a cover-up when his Starfleet Academy squadron suffers a deadly collision.
Preparing for her wedding aboard the Enterprise, Troi's free-thinking mother causes trouble between Worf and his son.
A beautiful woman, chosen by her people to serve as a peace offering to end a centuries-long war, falls in love with Picard.
A little girl's imaginary friend becomes a frightening reality for the crew when she threatens to destroy the Enterprise.
Picard and the crew suffer from conflicting emotions when the Enterprise rescues a critically-injured Borg.
Geordi and Ro are pronounced dead after a transporting maneuver from a distressed Romulan ship goes awry.
After a mysterious accident, Picard wakes up living the life of another person on a faraway planet.
After Data learns of his own death in late-19th-century San Francisco, a freak accident transports him back to that period.
The Enterprise crew travels between the 19th and 24th centuries in an attempt to prevent Data's death in 19th century San Francisco.
A young Enterprise engineer is forced to confront his paralyzing fear of being transported.
Troi is drastically transformed when a visiting ambassador secretly uses her to achieve his aims.
Trapped in limbo for 75 years, Star Trek's Scotty awakens to join the Next Generation in the 24th century.
Kes makes contact with Ocampa spacefarers and the female Caretaker, who may have the power to send the crew home.
The theft of a transporter module by Kazon forces thrusts Chakotay into an explosive confrontation with his traitorous former lover Seska.
Janeway must escape from a city under siege by the Mokra, a brutal regime determined to crush the growing resistance movement against it.
After Torres reactivates a humanoid robot, she's drawn into a war between robotic enemies.
Hoping to strengthen Voyager's strategic position in the quadrant, Janeway reluctantly seeks an alliance with the Kazon.
Paris makes history by becoming the first person to cross the transwarp threshold, but could pay for the achievement with his life.
Unable to come up with a logical motive for a shipboard murder, Tuvok performs a mind-meld with the perpetrator that brings out Tuvok's "killer instinct."
Torres races against time to stop a deadly self-guided missile on a collision course with disaster.
A rebel Q escapes from incarceration and demands asylum on Voyager so he can commit suicide.
The Doctor falls in love with a Vidiian woman stricken by the deadly Phage.
Neelix helps smoke out the crewmember who has been passing Federation secrets to the Kazon.
A space anomaly generates a duplicate Voyager and crew, but only one ship can survive an assault by Vidiian invaders.
After crash-landing on a moon, Tuvok encounters three terrified children who claim they've been brought there to die.
Thanks to a complex sensory system controlled by a computer, Kim and others are literally held hostage by fear.
A bizarre occurrence during transport causes Tuvok and Neelix to fuse into one alien humanoid known as "Tuvix."
After contracting a deadly virus, Janeway and Chakotay are forced into exile on a planet that shields them from the effects of the fatal disease.
Using Chakotay's son as a pawn, Seska lures Voyager into an explosive showdown with the Kazon.

Just as the team is beginning to lose hope, Col. Everett is sent from the Stargate Program on Earth. As Everett and the team strategize, a new battleship, the Daedalus, arrives with a new Zero Point Module, bringing with it new hope.

The team is saved with the arrival of Colonel Steven Caldwell, the Daedalus, and the destruction of the two approaching Wraith ships. McKay hopes the Zero Point Module will be the key to their success, meanwhile Ford seems off after an accident.

Sheppard starts to question things when strange malfunctions begin to occur after the team returns from a trip to Earth. The team discovers that the Daedalus has been infected with a Wraith Virus, causing the ship to go into survival mode.

The search for Lt. Ford leads Sheppard and Teyla to planet P3M-736 where they are captured by Ronon Dex, a man who is on the run, being hunted by the Wraith. The team offer to help Ronon, going up against the Wraith once again.

While on Planet Thenora, the team is shocked when McKay and marine officer Laura Cadman are suddenly taken aboard a Wraith Dart. When the team shoots down the Dart, they discover a technical glitch has put Cadman's consciousness in McKay's body.

With no recollection of how they got to the Destiny, crew members left behind over a year earlier make a mysterious return. After an unsettling turn, the memories stirred through regression therapy prove disastrous for those who’ve returned.

In the hopes of finding something beneficial, the crew follows an energy signature that leads them to a mysterious sea of lifeless ships. With no visible signs of danger, the crew set off to take a closer look. But things may not be what they seem.

Locked in a battle with a Drone Command Ship, the Destiny is surprised by the arrival of the aliens that abducted Rush and Chloe. After Destiny's position is revealed, the crew again comes under heavy attack. But this time, they have a plan.

Excitement spreads through the ship as Eli believes he’s found a way to dial Earth. But Dr. Rush has serious reservations about abandoning Destiny, and when the crew is interrupted by a distress call, it may just change the plans of the Destiny.

The Tok'ra must take refuge from the Goa'uld at the SGC Alpha Site occupied by Jaffa. Bad blood between the races begins to boil as an assassin wreaks havoc on the camp. Can O'Neill stop the bloodshed before the assassin escapes with coordinates?

SG-1 visits Pangar, a planet inhabited by humans who have developed a drug that makes their immune systems perfect. Unknown to SG-1 is the means by which the drug is produced, a startling discovery that may hold the key to the origins of the Tok'ra!

Rogue NSA officers hijack the X-303 spaceship and demand that Adrian Conrad be brought to the ship. Using his Goa'uld knowledge, Conrad activates the X-303 and takes the ship light-years from Earth as O'Neill and Teal'c stage a daring rescues.

When SG-1 is marooned in deep space, Thor comes to the rescue. He then seek O'Neill's help to combat the Replicators. Convinced they will attack earth if not stopped, O'Neill stages a daring mission to stop the Replicators once and for all.

SG-1 returns from a mission with an artifact that triggers the ability to see hideous yet harmless life forms in a parallel reality. As the effect spreads to civilians, O'Neill and his team must find a solution before mass hysteria breaks out.

Senator Kinsey suffers an assassination attempt while campaigning for the presidency, and O'Neill is caught on tape leaving the building where the shots were fired. With O'Neill behind bars, Carter, Teal'c and Jonas must prove his innocence.

Colonel Maybourne visits O'Neill and claims to have a key to a cache of alien technology, but demands a presidential pardon in exchange for it. When SG-1 accompanies Maybourne to retrieve it, they find his intentions may not be all they seem.

SG-1 discovers that Nirrti is mutating the inhabitants of an unexplored planet with a machine that rearranges their DNA. Captured in an attempt to stop her, O'Neill must find a way to escape before he and SG-1 are subjected to the same fate.

programmes.st: Ruby's Ranger Adventure // The Show Must Go On
programmes.d: During a camping trip in the forest, the Rainbow Village friends see a “monster” and almost cancel the trip. // When Princess Kiki chips her leg before a ballet performance, Rainbow Ruby must take the stage to save the day!
It’s the first day of spring in Strawberryland, at least it’s supposed to be, but with the cold winds blowing and frost on the ground it looks as though spring isn’t going to come this year.
Honey Pie Pony hurts her leg and must stay in bed instead of heading off for a grand adventure.
Strawberry’s cat Custard is shown to live a pampered, adored existence in Strawberry’s house. But Custard’s dream set-up is shattered by the sudden arrival of a rambunctious stray puppy.
Conniving Peppermint Fizz talks the other kids into a competition to see whose pet is best. Peppermint cheats so that her pet, Cola Chameleon, wins best pet.
Honey Pie Pony is feeling left out of all the kids’ play.  She’s the only one with four legs.  There’s no one like her to talk to and share her feelings.
When Sadiebug and Kadiebug create a new club, a 'Good Citizens Club,' Plum is suckered into doing their bidding, thinking that it's a 'test' for good citizenship.
Lemon and Raspberry have trouble collaborating on a decorating project, which causes all kinds of chaos... until they learn about teamwork.

Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden.  Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programmes.st: The Addams Family Goes To School
programmes.d: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read.  When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programmes.st: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programmes.d: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room.  They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector.  Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums.  When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez.  The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum.  The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programmes.st: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programmes.d: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy.  Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic.  Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs.  Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella.  Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programmes.st: Addams Family Meets The Undercover Man
programmes.d: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house.  While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career.  However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch.  Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid.  The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programmes.st: The Addams Family And The Spaceman
programmes.d: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters.  In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programmes.st: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s
programmes.d: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business.  The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programmes.d: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programmes.d: Jamie turns the humble aubergine into something incredible, then fires up the barbecue to cook a lunch of Cajun-spiced salmon tacos, served with a mango salsa in toasted tortillas.

programmes.t: Jamie's Easy Meals for Every Day
programmes.st: Prosciutto Pork Fillet; Easy Prawn Curry

Jamie cooks up a glorious mothership Roast Brisket of Beef with all the trimmings.
Jamie cooks crispy duck and hoisin lettuce parcels, chicken cacciatore, and spaghetti and smoky tomato sauce.
Moroccan bream; couscous salad; pomegranate and harissa; British burgers; shred salad; pickles and things.
Jamie makes jerk pork, grilled corn and crunchy tortilla salad, minestrone, poached chicken and salsa verde.
Jamie cooks Swedish meatballs, celeriac and spinach rice, plus pasta pesto, and garlic and rosemary chicken.

programmes.st: Green Tea Salmon and Modern Greek Salad
programmes.d: Green tea salmon; coconut rice and miso greens; modern Greek salad; spinach, chickpea and feta parcels.
Jamie prepares grilled steak, ratatouille and saffron rice, plus blackened chicken and San Fran quinoa salad.
Jamie rustles up pork steaks, Hungarian pepper sauce and rice, plus killer kedgeree, beans, greens and chilli yogurt.

programmes.st: Rosemary Chicken and Happy Cow Burgers
programmes.d: Rosemary chicken; grilled polenta and porcini tomato sauce; happy cow burgers; old school coleslaw; corn on the cob.

programmes.st: Sticky Squid Balls and Sausage Fusilli
programmes.d: Jamie cooks sticky squid balls, grilled prawns and noodle broth, plus sausage fusilli and creamy garden salad.
Sesame seared tuna; messy meatball buns; chocolate rye Cookies; chicken pot pie with a crispy crust.
Quick Asian fishcakes with a sweet and spicy glaze; lemony courgette linguine; sticky lamb chops; cherry chocolate mousse.
Cooking up a tender lamb shoulder; super green spaghetti, a speedy veggie pasta; one-pan fish; rice; apple crumble cookies.
Ginger beef and pak choi; crispy squid and smashed avocado; pork and mash gratin; almond, orange and polenta cake.
Pork burger; sticky mango prawns; easy rustic gnocchi; frozen banoffee cheesecake.
Jamie cooks up his tikka chicken, a very quick roast; making a vibrant carrot and grain salad and speedy crab spaghetti; for dessert, Jamie makes chocolate orange shortbread.
Stress-free sausage carbonara; spicy one-pot Thai red chicken soup; scrambled egg omelette; steamed puddings with sticky marmalade glaze.
Flaky pastry pesto chicken; spicy nduja vongole; surf and turf pasta; sausage bake; watermelon granita.
Sticky kickin' chicken wings; sirloin with aubergines; creamy garlic mushroom pasta; rum 'n' raisin ice cream.

programmes.t: 5 Simple Recipes to Cook at Home
programmes.d: A bite-sized clip selection of Jamie's most-loved recipes and kitchen moments.
Jamie helps actor Warwick Davis prepare beef and Stilton pie; a Vietnamese feast, hog roast, and British honey.
The boys welcome Chris O'Dowd and Dawn O'Porter and make their favorite honeymoon meal - Caribbean red snapper. Plus ribs with whisky and Worcestershire BBQ sauce.
Jamie Oliver cooks a traditional Caribbean chicken dish with singer Craig David. There's a roasted salmon and artichoke parcel and a look at seaweed as a superfood.
Jamie teaches Johnny Vegas how to flambé a steak and makes cannelloni with veal and nettles; Jimmy builds a beer pump.
Jamie shows actor Josh Hartnett how to cook his favourite ramen dish; a game and aubergine curry recipe; a taste of the future of farming.
