A former army captain comes to North Fork to kill the man who shot down his son in a gunfight - Lucas McCain.
A new store owner upsets the town by demanding all credit accounts be paid off.
The widow of a bandit killed by Lucas plots a grotesque revenge.
Mark and his friend become trapped in an old mine.
Lucas and Mark attempt to reform a con-man.
Lucas encourages a drunken artist charged with murder to use his talents to identify the true killer.
Lucas and Mark try to persuade a persecuted young mute to return stolen money.
A lively old lady arrives in town hot on the trail of a notorious bandit and the reward money for capturing him.
A doctor seeks revenge on the man he blames for ruining his practice.
Lucas unmasks a killer posing as a door-to-door seed salesman.
Lucas and Marshall Torrance run into trouble while transporting a captured killer back to face trial.
A deathbed request from an old friend sends Lucas to a neighboring town in search of the man's long-lost sweetheart.
Lucas thinks he has seen a ghost when a young man, eerily similar to a man he killed in the Civil War, challenges him to a gunfight.

Lucas agrees to take a job as an undercover agent and goes to investigate rumors of the sales of arms to renegade Indians. His life is endangered by the town drunk who stumbles onto his true identity.
While Lucas is in Wyoming on the trail of a gang illegally selling weapons to the Indians, Mark stays with Miss Milly, where he suffers from loneliness and doubt with his father gone for 2 months.
Lucas looks for answers when recovering alcoholic Micah Torrence returns to the bottle and turns in his badge.

programmes.st: The Lost Treasure of Canyon Town
programmes.d: In a ghost town, Lucas, Mark and Micah tangle with the Newman family and learn the secret of the town's 20-year-old mystery of a lost gold mine.
Blinded in an explosion, Lucas fights despair as he prepares for a meeting with a gun-toting enemy.
A deranged ex-prisoner of war, cruelly abused in a Northern army prison, captures Lucas, locks him in a cage and vows to make him suffer for his part in the Civil War.
A traveling salesman can't talk his way out of an assault charge.

programmes.st: Short Rope for a Tall Man
programmes.d: Lucas is threatened with hanging by a lynch party when some horses he has purchased in a neighboring town turn out to be stolen.
A janitor-turned-gunfighter's reputation hangs on one lucky shot and a lot of gall. The handyman finds himself in trouble when he accidentally kills another gunfighter.
Lucas tries to get help when he is shot after witnessing a murder.
After being foreman of a jury that convicted an Apache, Lucas is marked for death. Now, he must discover who is behind the curse.
Lucas allows some snowed-in stagecoach passengers to stay with him until the roads are passable. Trouble brews when the whiskey salesman and gunfighter fall for the same woman.
Two pranksters write away for a mail-order bride, using Lucas's name.
Lucas recognizes Dr. Battle as an ex-gunslinger with whom he once fought. He helps with a dying man, but Lucas and the doctor have unresolved anger.
A Chinese man and his son fight prejudice as they try to open a laundry in North Fork.
While Lucas and Mark are traveling across the Mexican desert they encounter a trio of Mexican bandits who demand payment to cross "their" desert.
Mark takes a job as a stable boy against his father's wishes.
Mark and Milly are held hostage in her general store when two gunmen attempt a daring robbery.
Two prison wagon drivers stop at the McCain ranch looking for whiskey. Lucas turns them down because they are escorting a murderer, to be hanged in Yuma.
Mark goes to work for Will Temple, a badly scarred, very mysterious rancher.

Mr. Wilson believes he sees a gremlin on the wing of the commercial aircraft he is taking back home... from the sanitarium, where he has been committed for six months after a mental breakdown during a similar flight.
A street salesman cleverly eludes Death. But if he lives, a little girl must die in his place.

Awakened by the cries of their daughter Bettina, Chris and Ruth Miller enter her room to find that she has vanished - even though they still hear her crying for help. Chris' physicist friend Bill thinks she moved into another dimension.
Riding home on the train one day, a man falls asleep and dreams it is 1880, and he is entering a small town called Willoughby.
While in the hospital recovering from overwork, Liz Powell keeps dreaming about going down to the hospital morgue.
A two-bit thug thinks he's found the key to a better life in an old sidewalk salesman who has the uncanny ability to tell people what they need the most.
Passing through the sound barrier a commercial airliner inadvertently travels back in time.

programmes.st: A Short Drink from a Certain Fountain
programmes.d: Trying to keep up with his younger wife, Harmon convinces his brother to inject him with an experimental youth serum.
The curator of a murderers' row in a soon-to-be-defunct wax museum persuades the owner to let him keep the figures for awhile.
Fortune discovers that a piano he bought his wife for her birthday has magical properties - the music that it plays makes people reveal their true essence.
A computer technician must deal with the queen of all femme fatales: a computer named Agnes who wreaks havoc on his love life.
Alan Richards plans to build a dam in Africa on a tribe's ancestral land. The tribe's witch doctor puts a curse on him.

An elderly private school teacher wonders if his life has meant anything as he contemplates suicide on Christmas Eve and is reminded by former students that he has, indeed, had an impact on their lives.
Alone on a cross-country trip, a woman continually sees the same hitch-hiker everywhere she looks.
An astronaut arrives back on Earth, then notices things have changed in his absence.
David Gurney wakes up to find that no one - his wife, his co-workers, his best friend, not even his own mother knows him.
Bartlett Finchley's paranoia about the machines around proves true.
When a nuclear attack appears imminent, several suburban friends and neighbors fight over control of a single bomb shelter.

programmes.st: And When the Sky Was Opened
programmes.d: Three astronauts have returned from this first space flight. Major Gart is hospitalized with a broken leg. The other two, Colonels Harrington and Forbes head for a bar. Harrington gets a strange feeling…
Before he died, notorious gunslinger Pinto Sykes put a curse on hired-gun Conny Miller. Miller returns to town and is challenged to visit the grave of Sykes, despite the curse.
A lonely old woman refuses to leave her apartment for fear of meeting "Mr. Death."
A compulsive gambler cajoles his friend to use his telekinesis to affect the results of the gambling tables in Las Vegas.
On the road home from the Civil War, a Confederate soldier stops at a burned-out house and gets to know the owner, a recent widow.
Walter Jameson is an excellent history teacher who talks about the past as if he had lived it.
A man, desperate to win the affection of a beautiful woman, slips her a love potion. He is overjoyed that the potion works so well...at first.

programmes.st: The Four of Us are Dying
programmes.d: A man who can change his face to resemble others gets into hot water with gangsters.
Using the power of mind over matter, Archibald Beechcroft remakes the world to his own specifications.
When three dum-dum crooks get ahold of a camera that takes pictures of the future, they set out to make a quick fortune with their new toy.
A dying man demands his family wear masks that he's given them at a Mardi Gras party.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Big Blackmail
programmes.d: A double-dealing foreign diplomat attempts to implicate the United States in an international conspiracy.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Doomsday Formula
programmes.d: Agents West and Gordon are determined to foil an ex-army general's plan to gain possession of a secret explosive formula.
A man uses a steam-driven juggernaut to drive off homesteaders so he can appropriate their oil-rich land.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Sedgewick Curse
programmes.d: Agents West and Gordon come across a physician plying a wealthy family with a drug that causes rapid aging.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Gruesome Games
programmes.d: Agents West and Gordon, searching for a powerful germ culture, invade the mansion of an eccentric millionaire.
A strange sea monster preying on Portuguese fishermen and their boats becomes the object of an investigation by agents West and Gordon.
West and Gordon must escape a Western town whose entire population is hunting them to free the prisoner they have taken.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Egyptian Queen
programmes.d: Secret Service agent James West seeks to find a missing ruby for an Egyptian Princess.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Fire And Brimstone
programmes.d: Agents West and Gordon determine to foil the recovery of a fortune that was originally destined to help the Confederate cause.
A meek secret agent, whom West and Pike first feel will be a detriment, proves to be invaluable as they deal with an opium ring.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Avaricious Actuary
programmes.d: A sinister scientist who employs a monstrous tuning fork as an instrument of extortion becomes James West's antagonist.
West meets up again with his old enemy, Dr. Miguelito Loveless, who is engaged in a whimsical plan for wholesale murder.
Secret Agent West challenges a bizarre scheme to control San Francisco Bay Shipping with rockets fired from Alcatraz Island.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Spanish Curse
programmes.d: People living in New Mexico border towns are being terrified by a mysterious outlaw gang known as "Cortez and his Conquistadores."

programmes.st: The Night Of The Winged Terror (Part 1)
programmes.d: Agent West vows to destroy Raven, an organization that induces influential citizens to commit sabotage through mind conditioning.

programmes.st: The Night Of The Winged Terror (Part 2)
programmes.d: Agent West's bizarre behavior convinces his cohorts that he has become another victim of the Raven's mind-conditioning plot.

An occurrence at Area 51 swaps Mulder's consciousness with a stranger’s.

To boost Jack's confidence, Terri turns on the charm, causing Janet to suspect that her new roommate's interest in Jack is more than platonic.
When Jack's never-ending schemes to endear himself to a beautiful woman totally backfire, he decides to forego his little white lies for honesty.
Jack's attempted romance with Felipe's beautiful cousin, Maria, is plagued by problems - Janet, Terri, Maria's inability to speak English, and Maria's fiancé.
Chrissy and Janet have to solve a gourmet mystery to help Jack graduate from cooking school.
Jack angrily leaves and becomes a live-in cook for Larry's boss and his passionate wife. Guest Star(s): John Larroquette
Instead of catching sleep in the dingy apartment above his restaurant, Jack catches Mr. Angelino with a young woman.
To avoid a woman's angry boyfriend, Jack joins his roommates for a weekend on a farm owned by Cindy's Aunt Becky.

Jack meets an old flame at the park who is seeking advice about her jealous husband. Furley joins them, and they all get poison oak. Later, at Jack's house, Furley tells the husband they were all in the bushes together.
Jack and Janet are shocked as evidence mounts that Chrissy seems compelled to steal, not only from them but also from the Ropers.
Jack, realizing he can't meet his obligations to pay his share of the rent, gets a part-time modeling job only to find out that he's expected to pose nude. Guest Star(s): Sally Kirkland
Curious landlord Stanley Roper sneaks a peek at an X-rated diary Chrissy is typing and suddenly gets the idea that Chrissy is in love with him.
A fault-finding efficiency expert drives Janet to quit her job at the flower shop.
A case of mistaken identity lands Jack an impressive chef's post that makes him the unwitting target of a bullying bookie and the local police.
When Jack, Chrissy, and Janet set out for a gourmet dinner for the Ropers - designed to stave off an expected rent hike - the " meanest" sailor from Jack's navy days arrives and wrecks the evening.
Overprotective Janet goes into a rage when she finds Jack in the same bed with her attractive sister - who is visiting.

Janet's date, a newspaper writer, offers to do a column on the trio's methods of coping with inflation. The published article, however, insinuates that their living arrangement is more intimate than practical.
Jack breaks a date with Janet to coach a nervous Larry, who's hoping to romance Terri with a smooth conversation.
Jack becomes entangled in a feud between his two roommates when Janet accuses Chrissy of stealing a handsome young executive from her.
Jack believes Chrissy's friend is the perfect sweetie to bring home to mom, until Janet discovers she's a high-priced call girl headed for a wild convention.
Jack becomes caught in a dilemma when Chrissy believes he has bought her an expensive birthday present and the gift turns out to be a surprise for Roper's wife.
When an absent-minded policeman leaves his handcuffs at the trio's apartment, Chrissy and Jack playfully slap the cuffs on each other and then discover there's no key. Guest Star(s): Heather Lowe
Only Jack knows the truth when Chrissy, Janet, and Mrs. Roper think that Stanley is fooling around with another woman.
Jack Tripper, a chef for all seasons, turns out to be quite a dish himself when he disguises himself as roommate Chrissy to skirt FBI agents on his trail.
All work no play makes Jack an angry boy when Janet hires him to work for her and acts like a tough boss.
Chrissy's good fortune at the racetrack leaves the three roommates with money to burn but tempers sizzle over the distribution of the wealth.

Jack offers to model for a beautiful art teacher and finds himself nude in front of her classroom when Furley walks in. Jack begs Furley not to tell, but the secret is out when a nude portrait of Jack appears at the Regal Beagle.

An unexpected visit from Chrissy's father, the minister, throws the kids into a panic. Jack decides to move out temporarily but Reverend Snow arrives before Jack can leave. Fumbling for an explanation, Janet blurts out that she and Jack are married.
Three's company, but four's a weird crowd when Ralph Furley loses his job and moves in with Jack, Janet, and Cindy.
Jack finds himself in a state of panic when he juggles three gourmet dinners in three different apartments.
Janet learns that Cindy's boss is asking for favors above and beyond the call of duty.
Jack panics when he suspects Terri's friend wants to give up her life as a nun and marry him.
Jack defends Chrissy's honor when a man who misunderstood her friendliness shows up at the apartment and no one knows he's a cop. Guest Star(s): James Cromwell

On December 13th, 1991 James Toney and Mike McCallum fought eachother for the first time at the Convention Hall in Atlantic City for IBF World Middleweight title ending in a draw.

On August 29th, 1992, James Toney rematched Mike McCallum for the IBF Middleweight Title in Reno. This time, Toney came out on top via a majority decision in which many believed the scorecards were too lopsided in favor of Toney.
On February 22nd, 1997 James Toney and Mike McCallum face each other for the final time at the Mohegan Sun Casino in Uncasville in a strong bout that lasted 12 rounds ending in a victory for Toney.
On March 5th, 1994 James Toney and Tim Littles fought at the Olympic Auditorium in Los Angeles for IBF World Super middleweight titles resulting in a technical knockout victory for Toney.

Josh rides to Barney Durant's horse business to rent a couple of horses right after Barney pushes his son David to leave.
On the trail of a Cavalry deserter and the horses he stole, Josh rides into a town ruled as the private fiefdom of its autocratic, psychopathic marshal who is holding the horses and deserter.
A grieving father who is the town drunk hires Josh Randall with his last $30 to find his murdered son's body, but Josh's search for clues runs up against a cowardly conspiracy of silence.
Josh expects a $400 bounty for bringing in Daniel Trenner but finds his prisoner stolen from him by the sheriff.
Hired by a father to bring back the man who killed his son Josh is surprised when he doesn't get paid because he brought the man back alive.
Josh reluctantly takes a job protecting a beautiful deaf, mute, teenage girl and keeping everyone off the father's place for a day or two.

programmes.d: Not comfort and rest but capture and torture await Major Liam Mars when he arrives by stage at Crazy Creek station, in company with Traveler Bat Masterson and Miss Lottie Tremaine.

Western-Developer Bat Masterson helps Clyde Richards' crew build a road westward from Nevada to California. Chief obstacles to progress: the bitter mountain cold, and conspirators against the railroad.
Daphne Kaye, a blackjack dealer at Bat Materson's casino, officiates while gambler George Winston breaks the bank. She ends up out of work and Bat ends up out one casino.
Bat Masterson is a gambler, empire-builder, Indian-fighter and journalist.  He uses his derringer and gold-headed cane to win the justice he believes to be right.
Poker champ Bat Masterson has important testimony to offer at the trial of H.C. Smith, charged with murdering Bat's friend during a card game.

After encountering a woman burying her fiancee in an unmarked grave, Paladin is persuaded to go after the deceased's killer.
Paladin must track down a marshal's son accused of a shooting and persuade him to turn himself into the authorities.
Paladin is hired to deliver three mail-order brides to Bend-In-The-River.
Paladin is traveling on a stagecoach with four others, one of whom is Della White Cloud, the educated daughter of an Apache chief.
Sid Morgan hires Paladin to protect him from someone who is trying to kill him. After killing the gunfighter who was following them, Paladin finds out the real reason Morgan hired him.
Paladin is hired to protect the Avery family from Manuel Garcia. Garicia is a Mexican bandit who seems to have taken a special interest in their son.

Hollister captures outlaw Lafe Jackson who is on his way to a rendezvous with his gang to divide the proceeds of a robbery. Lafe kills both horses, forcing Clay to take his prisoner in on foot, giving Lafe's gang time to catch up and rescue him.

Sheriff Hollister gives the job of the jailer to Barton Clark who has recently come West. The Sheriff brings Clark his first 'tenant,' a beautiful outlaw known as Rose of Rio Bravo with whom Clark falls in love, leading him to double-cross Hollister.

Adam Kirby witnesses a murder in the livery stable; then makes the mistake of 'shooting off his mouth about it, leading to the killer coming after him. Sheriff Hollister 'baits' a trap with Kirby and waits...to trap the killer and save Kirby.

Harvey Logan and his gunfighters take over the town of Sunglow and have themselves on a spree. Notified that the telegraph line to Sunglow is dead, Sheriff Hollister and editor Claibourne ride over to investigate and are trapped and thrown into jail.

Fugitive Logan Beatty hides out at the ranch of Alan Danbury. Danbury's daughter Kay, falling in love with the outlaw, helps disarm Sheriff Hollister when he comes to arrest Beatty. Hollister, Beatty, and Kay's father battle for the girl.

Beautiful Elizabeth Blythe (Allison Hayes) comes from New York to Tombstone to write a story about 'the town too tough to die.' Her nose for news promptly leads her into mortal danger when she is captured by outlaw Ed Chandler (Don Kennedy).
Costigan is a land owner and cattleman. He was shot by Clemenceau, a squatter on his land. Paladin has offered to help him get rid of the squatter but doesn't approve of his methods.
Tamsen Sommers is advertising for a husband, which presents a problem since she already has one. The husband hires Paladin to protect him from the men competing for the right to marry her.
Paladin is hired to escort a Rani and her party across 150 miles of desert to a safe haven. The Rani is from a country fighting a civil war and she is to be the new leader if her side is victorious.
When Paladin goes to a mining town to promote a prizefight, his boxer is arrested and he ends up having to take the man's place in the ring -- against the Welsh champion.
Newlyweds with no place to stay end up in Paladin's suite. He learns that the groom's half-brothers are threatening to kill their father. Paladin goes to warn the father.

Hunters drop everything in order to deal with life threatening gators and unexpected setbacks. One team sacrifices their day to go after a gator that is terrorizing kids at a local camp.

Swampers push the limits of their property lines in order to salvage their day. One team accidentally crosses boundaries with an angry landowner. One hunter avoids a crowded swamp by venturing into a remote hunting area.
Mysterious forces blanket the swamp pushing hunters to their limits. One hunter risks his life by venturing into a cursed area. Another hunter encounters an unexpected fish kill.
Dice enlists the help of Sam and Cat to convince Goomer's mother that Goomer is a high school teacher.
Sam and Cat make a commercial for their business that features Dice's dog; a family claims that Dice's dog belongs to them.
Sam opens a safe in her bedroom and discovers a tunnel leading to a secret room; Cat films herself for 24 hours.
Sam and Cat are hired to baby-sit a doll on Halloween; Cat thinks she may have turned Dice into a monkey.
Tori and the gang compete to see who can get the most followers on The Slap.  But when they get caught up in the competition, they neglect their schoolwork and their friendships.
Tori wins a contest to sing the opening number at a big music awards show, but the producer wants to totally change her look and behavior. Tori agrees, but finds that she doesn't like her new image.

After Tori fills in for her ailing sister in a big musical showcase, Tori is asked to enroll at an elite performing arts high school.  But once there, Tori struggles to fit in to her new surroundings.
Tori goes all out to master an iconic Hollywood Arts monologue in Sikowitz's class.  Meanwhile, André and Robbie join a ballet class to meet girls, with disastrous results.
Tori has to defend herself after Jade claims Tori hurt her in a stage fighting exercise.  Meanwhile, Trina has to fend off Robbie's advances when he thinks their stage kiss meant something.
Tori accidentally gets Beck fired from a small role in a movie, then must figure out a way to get him his job back.  Meanwhile, Robbie suffers frightening nightmares about his best friend Rex.
Tori gets the lead in a high profile school musical, but freaks out when a stage makeup project goes awry, and she's left looking like a zombie on opening night.
After a jealous Jade dumps Beck, she soon regrets it and recruits Tori to help get him back.  Meanwhile, Trina puts on a one-woman show and tells Robbie he better give it a good review… or else!
Tori struggles to find the perfect birthday gift for Trina, then decides to write her sister a song as a present.  An ungrateful Trina turns the song into cash by selling it, enraging Tori.

Tori suggests Robbie capture videos of students' everyday lives to increase his blog traffic, but when the camera is turned on Tori, she asks him to stop.  Only Robbie doesn't and Tori realizes she's created a monster.

programmes.t: Victorious: A Film by Dale Squires
programmes.d: When a hot young filmmaker comes to Hollywood Arts, the kids are excited to work on his project.  But when the film is released, and they aren't given credit, the kids turn to revenge.
As the kids prepare for a big play, Rex is accidentally sucked into a giant fan and Tori is responsible.  Robbie is an emotional wreck, and it's up to Tori to save the day by saving Rex's life.
Sikowitz recruits the gang to form a children's band for a friend's party.  When a leaked video of the group's performance becomes popular, Andre struggles to be taken seriously as a musician.

Cat begins dating Tori's ex-boyfriend, Danny (Matt Angel) and Tori becomes jealous. Meanwhile, Trina convinces Robbie, Andre, Jade and Beck to indulge their feet in callus-eating fish that she's been buying from some stranger.
Sikowitz invites the gang to have a sleepover at his house in order to teach them a lesson in method acting.
The kids are excited to hear that they'll be the stars of a new reality show being filmed at Hollywood Arts. Meanwhile, Trina and Robbie are forced to work at The Grub Truck after injuring Festus.
Tori discovers that her friends have been secretly going to a fancy restaurant instead of playing in an annual ping pong tournament.
Tori agrees to help Jade find a theater to perform a play Jade wrote. But when the sponsor demands changes that will ruin Jade's play, Tori has to make things right before opening night.

A heat wave hits LA and the gang heads for the beach in Beck's RV. But once there, they find themselves trapped inside the RV as the temperature rises. Oblivious, Cat parties it up with some cute boys.
Tori's flight home is delayed, leaving her no time to finish a school project with her friends. She attempts to get the work done with them over video chat, but things keep getting in the way.
Spencer has a new nemesis - Chuck's more menacing younger brother, Chip! Meanwhile, Freddie fixes Gibby's toy phaser and gives it a power he never imagined!
When Carly bans T-Bo from the loft, he retaliates by not letting Carly into the Groovy Smoothie. Meanwhile, Freddie and Gibby discover being in a band has many perks and a few drawbacks.
When Sam learns her mom is in a Vegas jail, the gang decides to gather their most prized possessions, drive to Vegas and pawn their stuff to make enough money to bail her out.
Sam's friend gets out of juvy and Sam warns everyone to stay away, but Carly doesn't listen and finds herself in over her head. Back at the loft, Spencer finds a pair of night vision goggles.
When Sam's laptop gets stolen, the iCarly gang tries to help track down the thief.
Carly wants her dad to escort her to an important dance, but when he can't make it a very sick Spencer tries to help her out.  Meanwhile, Sam fixes a motorcycle and Freddie gets a new phone.
After Jimmy Fallon mentions iCarly on his late night show, the gang does a tribute webcast to him. Jimmy sees it and invites them to New York to appear on his show.

The lead detective wrapped up his testimony. Karen Read's defense team grilled him about his conduct during the investigation into John O'Keefe's death.

Investigators looking into John O'Keefe's death seemed confident in their conclusion that Karen read fatally hit her boyfriend with her SUV and then drove away. On the stand was Detective Lieutenant Brian Tully of the Massachusetts State Police.

Lorena Bobbitt emotionally recalled her version of the night she cut off her husband's penis. She claimed things started with a vicious rape, and then it ended with her with a knife mutilating John.

Lorena Bobbitt answered questions under cross-examination. Prosecutors alleged that she intentionally severed her husband John's penis out of frustration with their sex life and the possibility of a divorce.

John and Lorena Bobbitt had been separated for one whole year. Their relationship was central to both sides in her trial. She was on the stand trying to explain to the jury what led to that separation and why they reunited.
Lorena Bobbitt continued answering questions under cross-examination. She reiterated her point that she mutilated her husband, John, after he raped her that night.

Joshua Aide is on trial for the murder of his ex-girlfriend's father, as well as her attempted murder and that of a family friend. He claims he was ambushed by the three who were plotting to kill him and cash in on his life insurance policy.

When a young college student disappears on her evening run, investigators scour her small town searching for her; when her accused attacker takes the stand, the story becomes more complicated than expected.

When an entire family is found in a decaying pile of bodies by the side of a Florida road, the hunt is on to find what police fear might be two more victims; a man and his son are found alive, launching a bizarre investigation.
Romance novelist Nancy Brophy faces life in prison for the murder of her husband; she is set to testify in her own defense and her attorneys launch a full-fledged effort to paint her as a creative.

When Ben Renick is found dead in his snake facility, law enforcement assumes he is a victim of one of his snakes -- until the coroner finds bullet casings hidden behind shelves; three years of investigation eventually lead police to Ben's wife.

Stay-at-home mom Danielle Redlick is charged with the murder of her husband, pro sports executive Michael Redlick; after holding onto her account for nearly three years, Danielle finally takes the witness stand and her story takes a turn.

Curtis Reeves stands accused of murdering Chad Oulson over popcorn at a matinee movie; the defense claims he acted in self defense while the state's prosecutors argue that Reeves was short-tempered and unjustified in the shooting.

Shock runs through a community when a wealthy businessman is found murdered in South Carolina.

After decades on the run, a serial killer faces tough questions in the interrogation room; after a woman is found dead in the middle of the road, the finger pointing begins when three suspects are interviewed.

In the summer of 1999, Texas was terrorized by a brutal serial killer who traveled by train.  The FBI assembled a task force to gather information about the dangerous drifter and create a profile that would help locate him.  As they learned that the killer had traveled extensively through the United States and Mexico, the murders became more frequent, and authorities had to cast a dragnet over an entire continent in an effort to catch him.

In September 1997, a team of masked gunmen robbed an armored car facility in Los Angeles, and made off with $18.9 million, the largest takeover heist in U.S. history.  An employee believed she recognized the voice of one of the robbers, and FBI agents began conducting surveillance on a former employee of the facility.  With only one piece of physical evidence, a fragment of a vehicle taillight, authorities hoped to connect him to the crime, and locate his accomplices.

In July 1996, two men entered a pawnshop in Birmingham, Alabama, and ruthlessly murdered the employees.  Unbeknownst to the killers, a secret video surveillance camera recorded the shooting.  Local police and the FBI released images of the crime to the media, and were quickly able to identify the perpetrators.  Now authorities had to find two cold-blooded killers who knew that they were being pursued for murder one.

After a career criminal committed a vehicular homicide in New Orleans, FBI agents tracked him through his habits and addictions.  They focused their investigation on gambling communities throughout the country and, when he resurfaced in Atlantic City, authorities used all of their resources to trap an elusive sociopath who claimed that he would never be taken alive.

In the early 1980's, a pair of serial bank robbers gained a reputation among law enforcement officials as formidable bandits.  Using the same modus operandi, the two men took hostages and emptied bank vaults across the Midwest.  After the criminals escaped from police custody, FBI agents familiar with the bandits believed that they would attempt a grand-scale heist.  By conducting surveillance on known associates of the criminals, authorities tried to anticipate the next target.

Corruption in the New Orleans Police Department grew like a cancer in the early 1990's.  Lured by the easy wealth of the narcotics industry, crooked cops began breaking the laws they were sworn to uphold. They would stop at nothing, including murder, to protect their rackets. When it became clear they could no longer police themselves, the FBI got involved. Putting their lives on the line, undercover agents devised a way to flush out the violent cops and restore trust in the city's police force.

After a series of brutal bank robberies and murders in south Miami during the mid-1980's, the FBI embarked on an exhaustive eight-month investigation.  With little evidence and no suspects, agents were willing to try anything to find the violent perpetrators.  On April 11, 1986, agents conducting routine surveillance spotted the vehicle used in the bank robberies.  They attempted to arrest the two suspects in the car.  What followed was the bloodiest firefight in FBI history.

In Wisconsin, a varsity athlete is blindfolded, gagged, and shoved into a van by four gunmen.  The kidnappers contact the victim's family and demand $30,000, but offer no instructions on how to transfer the money.  The victim's family contacts the police.  The boy's captors tell his family they have shot him, and will kill him if they do not receive their money.  At an agreed upon drop site, FBI agents approach the captor's vehicle, only to watch them flee and quickly be followed by authorities.

In the southwest one serial bank robber claimed his loot went to the poor, but this thief was no folk hero.  He had a gun and was willing to shoot.  The gunman was desperate to stay free, a threat to anyone in his way.  The FBI and U.S. marshals teamed up to capture a resourceful criminal who proved he would never stop fighting.

In June 1973, a young girl was abducted from a state park on the Missouri River while camping with her family.  Several months passed with no leads, then an FBI agent took a particular interest in the case.  Using a new technique known as criminal profiling, he predicted that the kidnapper would contact the girl's family on the one-year anniversary of her abduction.  When this prediction came true, the FBI agent noted behavioral clues, hoping that they could lead him to the kidnapper.

Agents must find a way to bring down the organization before their civil war leads to innocent causalities.

programmes.t: Bringing Down The House: The Bombing of Harvey's Casino
programmes.d: In the summer of 1980, two men wheeled what looked like an IBM computer into a Lake Tahoe casino. The events that followed rocked the industry, baffled bomb technicians, and changed the lives of a criminal’s and a casino magnate’s family forever.

A powerful look at the history of Native American boarding schools as told through the stories of tribal members and their surviving family members, who endured an educational system founded on the concept “Kill the Indian in him, and save the man.”
Tonight we celebrate some holiday constants. For generations, children in Greater Boston visited the Enchanted Village with a sense of holiday wonder.

Couldn’t we all use a laugh? Tonight we connect with local comics who find “funny” everywhere they look. We meet up with Worcester teacher-turned-standup Orlando Baxter, and talk to Stephanie Peters, who used laughter to raise funds for the people of Ukraine. We check out a brand new comedy club in Beverly and connect with former Saturday Night Live writer Sam Jay, who reflects on her Dorchester roots. And is it possible to teach funny? At Emerson College, we find out.

Get your “spuckie” rolls ready – we’ve prepared a second helping of home plates! Shayna Seymour introduces us to more of those quirky, creative dishes known and enjoyed only in specific New England towns. Shayna samples “dynamites” – a staple on banquet tables in one particular Rhode Island city. What’s a steamed cheeseburger? In central Connecticut, we find out. And finally, a trip to Maine yields “red snappers” (no, we don’t mean lobster), washed down with Vacationland’s favorite retro soda.

Tonight, Shayna Seymour catches up with AJ Dybantsa. Also, Anthony Everett challenges an 8-year-old national chess champ to a match, while Erika Tarantal takes a lesson from the youngest-ever senior world champion in fencing!
It’s another installment in our look at beloved “hole in the wall” restaurants, including hot dogs in Hopkinton (and Lowell!), Ukrainian cakes in Brighton, and a souped-up corner store in Cambridge.
Tonight the Chronicle team puts work aside in favor of… play! From drone-racing, to stone-skipping, to card games and more.

Anthony Everett tours a unique home for sale, where the proceeds are targeted for charity thanks to the wishes of its prominent late owner. We travel to Great Barrington, where a couple has lovingly restored a chapel on the grounds of a former private school, built in memory of three members of the community who died tragically – and now a respite for hikers along the Appalachian Trail. We visit Arcade Snacks in Auburn and Q’s Nuts in Somerville for their veritable nut buffets and choices. We learn about the benefits of acorn flour and how to make it. We are also introduced to high-powered almond butter, courtsy of local Bear Butter and discover how local researchers are trying to tame nut allergies in patients.
We may not be able to run 26.2 miles, but we can definitely travel that distance in search of good food! Tonight, the Chronicle team is eating our way from Hopkinton to Boston.
The Ground Round, Tech Hi-Fi, Strawberries Records – all popular local brands, all brought back to life with new local ventures. We check them out tonight.

programmes.t: The Best of Chronicle: Main Streets and Back Roads
programmes.d: Who says you can’t go home again? Tonight we hitch a ride with Nicole Estaphan to her hometown of Grafton, Massachusetts. This rural Central Mass. town may be small but it packs big flavors - warm loaves at Bread Guy Breads and a global selection of fine wine and cheeses at Pecorino. Grafton is also home to the world's largest collection of antique Willard Clocks. And far from Tufts University’s Medford campus is the university’s Grafton training ground for future veterinarians, Cummings School

There are historic homes, and then there is the house Anthony Everett visits tonight in Plympton – a saltbox Colonial built in 1669, and now up for sale. In Central Mass., we meet a family of Model-T Ford aficionados, and in Boston’s North End we catch up with the stars of a YouTube series exploring neighborhood history.

Who needs the East End of Long Island? The New Hampshire Seacoast offers its own “Hamptons” and they boast their own ocean views, historic charm, and unique characters.
The Ground Round, Tech Hi-Fi, Strawberries Records – all popular local brands, all brought back to life with new local ventures. We check them out tonight.

Just six miles from downtown Boston, Malden is experiencing a renaissance. We stop by District Kitchen for handmade noodles and dumplings and check out the local art at Gallery at 57. Meanwhile, if you think you know Paul Revere’s turf, we have news for you from the town of Canton – where we hit the Paul Revere Heritage Site and Northern Spy restaurant, which focuses on locally-sourced ingredients. Ted Reinstein is looking up, down, around, and above to discover quirky systems, codes, and features around Boston that are “hiding in plain sight!” Parts of the city are encircled by a high-wire “eruv” – Ted will tell you what that is. We meet a Boston man who makes art in out-of-the-way places (and manages to live rent-free in the city). Boston officials share the story behind those tiny colored plastic disks embedded in city streets. And while the 1,200 fire alarm boxes in Boston may look lik

Quincy Center is hopping, with a redesigned downtown and new eateries drawing crowds. We check out the restaurants and retail, and Anthony Everett tours the square with the mayor to get the lowdown on the building boom. Up in Salem, we’re bypassing the “witch thing” to check out the city’s other attractions, including its annual film festival. Finally, a visit to Norwood - where a huge vintage market is a big draw for shoppers and a new grocer is transforming the shopping chore.

Massachusetts is home to more than 300,000 military veterans, and tonight we talk to several about the challenges and the opportunities after completing service. We meet a Marine who discovered a therapeutic outlet in gardening, and with his family launched a community garden to help other vets. We also visit veteran-owned businesses and meet those who are committed to honoring fallen heroes. Finally, we talk with a 100-year-old World War II vet who shares memories of his experiences.
Chronicle's award-winning team brings you the stories of New England.

Massachusetts has dozens of “mill towns” and tonight we’re exploring how some of these industrial-era buildings are serving a new generation – offering everything from freshly-roasted coffee to fine art.

Ever wonder what kind of genius is being conjured inside the labs at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology? Tonight we take a peek and discover everything from video games to futuristic fashion to… paper airplanes!

programmes.d: A stranger than fiction documentary that chronicles a semi-scripted extreme sporting league that premiered in 2000. Socker Slam took elements of wrestling, rugby and “butts up” shenanigans and body slammed them into a soccer drama.

(2022) The disappearance of Johnny Gosch is one of Iowa's longest running, and most notorious mysteries. In 1982, the 12-year-old paperboy in West Des Moines vanished without a trace. Forty years later, KCCI uncovers where the investigation stands.
Tonight NewsCenter 5’s Maria Stephanos joins us with profiles of local luminaries who have made giving back to their communities their mission.

February is American Heart Month, and Nicole Estaphan is sharing personal stories that stress the importance of awareness, early screening, and prevention. Nicole meets a transplant recipient who had no warning of his life-threatening disease, and a young mom who suffered a heart attack while pregnant – one of a growing number of younger patients who experience a cardiac event. She talks to doctors about risk and the importance of a heart-healthy lifestyle. Finally, Nicole shares her own diagnos
Tonight we meet local children and adults with autism spectrum disorder; the families who support them; and the range of programs that help them to live full – and fulfilling – lives.

New Englanders dream all fall, winter, and spring about summertime. And when the temperature finally goes up, we start searching for ways to cool down! One often-overlooked option, says Ted Reinstein, is the region’s lakes. From a summer concert shed on Webster Lake to ‘Busta Rhymes Island’ – tonight we discover there is lots to *lake* about New England.

Tonight Erika meets experts at The New England Centenarian Study at Boston University. Erika explores other links to longevity, and visits a Marshfield school where young children regularly spend time with seniors from a local residential community.

Hidden Gems aren’t hard to find in New England (if you know where to look!). Tonight we follow the breadcrumbs to a French bakery tucked into a liquor store in Milford. Forget candlepins - we’re checking out a duckpin bowling alley, and dining on the “Mystery Monday” menu at Metacom Kitchen in Warren, R.I.. And tucked into a former Methodist Church in Charlton, Mass., is a sewing “sanctuary” that’s still lifting spirits. Plus, we head to Gillette Stadium to meet the New England Revolution -- a r
The latest news, weather, and sports from the WCVB NewsCenter 5 Team.

Tonight we’re back on the hunt for hidden history. Anthony Everett visits Brockton where he rides on a historic fire engine that battled the devastating Strand Theatre fire in 1941, and a local museum remembers the 13 lives lost. We take a stroll with the author of “Boston’s Oldest Buildings and Where to Find Them.” And tucked away among the storefronts inside the Prudential Center are actual relics of three Catholic saints.

"Key Bridge Disaster: Reflect, Recover, Rebuild," examines the lives impacted in the hours, days and months following the collapse, telling the stories of first responders, workers at the Port of Baltimore, business owners and employees, and the people living in nearby communities.

Costumes are a part of the fabric that makes up New Orleans. As three local designers will find out – nothing is easy in the Big Easy as they compete in creating one-of-a-kind costumes inspired by the Crescent City and the river that shapes it.

Uncover the Midwest's unexpected. From quirky to inventive flavor mash-ups like the bulgogi burger to the questionable sour cream & raisin pie, see how the area crafts some interesting but delightful culinary concoctions.
Brendan tackles cleaning a hot dragstrip with a flamethrower, converts a basketball arena into a hockey rink, and sets the stage on opening night for Orlando's latest live music venue!
Lowrider Legacy follows celebrated lowrider families, scholars, and activists and documents the history of resistance on wheels that has defined lowrider culture.
The latest news and weather from the WBAL 11 News Team.

It's the war on I-4! In a clash of the traditional and the experimental, The Milk District takes on Lake Buena Vista. Will Chef Ian Russell of Smoke & Donuts bring the heat or will Chef Norberto of El Patron smoke the competition?

Jessie Fiacco is a single mother and nurse, who during the pandemic made home visits. But Jessie hasn’t made time for herself. Luckily for her, Kinga is in town to show Jessie she doesn’t have to travel far to get far out.
From a popular new pro volleyball team drawing huge crowds, to a former football pro who now coaches e-sports, these Nebraskan athletes show how to seize the moment.

programmes.t: Hit Me With Your Best Spot
programmes.d: In Kansas City, local notables Shawn Barber, Charlie Hustle and Nikki Vivas tell you why you need to suit up for electro-muscle stimulation, where to target a good time with ax throwing and how to find an underground speakeasy.

programmes.t: Refugees Welcome: A Story of Immigration to America’s Heartland
programmes.d: Refugees Welcome documents how one Governor’s brave decision to welcome refugees during the Vietnam War had far reaching repercussions not only for the country but, generations later, for the fate of his own family.
Weeks after a pregnant woman is shot and killed in Orlando, a shootout between her suspected killer and a police officer sparks a manhunt.

Discover where classic dishes collide to create delightful flavors. From pizza debates to the Juicy Lucy to a good old-fashioned red beer, see how regional creativity transforms beloved foods into something more.
The latest news and weather from the WBAL 11 News Team.

Gear up for ghost hunting in an abandoned asylum, bring your appetite for brats, and belly-up to the bar at a saloon frequented by locals. Tour a bakery with nice buns, and end the day getting cozy in an A-frame.
The latest news and weather from the WBAL 11 News Team.

In 1977, people across Pittsburgh live in fear as a string of brutal killings sends detectives on a chase to catch the shotgun slayer. He invades homes and senselessly attacks with a shotgun, knives and hammers in the dead of night.

programmes.t: The Roller Coaster Wars That Birthed a Beast
programmes.d: In 2006, two dozen roller coaster riders landed in the hospital after a freak malfunction in Ohio. This is the story of Kings Island: how its thrilling – and sometimes nail-biting – history spawned one of America’s greatest amusement parks.
In Milwaukee, 19-year-old Sade Robinson has gone missing, and her car is found torched. A trail of evidence across the city shocks the community and leaves her family searching for justice.
Ed and Day get competitive over a round of golf and learn a new twist on old fashion cocktail making before heading to Apis Meadery in Carnegie.
The latest news, weather, and sports from the WBAL-TV newsroom.
An Omaha home pottery artist, and a spider web-catching jewelry maker in Boston.
The latest news, weather, and sports from the WBAL-TV Newsroom.

programmes.t: Lost Innocence: The Tragedy of Harmony Montgomery
programmes.d: A police investigation into a missing seven-year-old girl in Manchester, New Hampshire reveals harrowing details that shock the state. But even more disturbing is the discovery that the tragic outcome could have been avoided.

Welcome to Lancaster, PA, one of the country's hottest retirement hubs. Here, seniors, from a beauty pageant queen to a 90 year-old swim champion aren’t slowing down; they’re rewriting the playbook and redefining aging in America.
Esquire’s Dave Holmes and chef and author Ronnie Woo share must-sees in Milwaukee!
Rob proves that this iconic locale is more than just Ivy League. He makes pasta from scratch, crafts a custom knife and tries to make an escape from one of the toughest spots in all of Beantown.

A beloved University of Kentucky football player is murdered on the porch of his house during his 21st birthday party in an assassination-style killing. What leads to the shooter's capture is equally shocking.

Nycid Velasquez is a young mother with crippling social anxiety. Kinga takes Nycid on a life-changing adventure from thrill riding on ATVs to taking a plunge with sharks. In the process, Nycid discovers the confidence she’s been missing.
Chefs Jason Hisley and Amanda Mack are going head to head in a sweet treats challenge. Can the chefs create a winning sweet and savory meal? Or will this be a sugar rush they want to forget?
Experience serious vacation vibes and discover some of the most special corners of America on this guided tour of must-visit cities.

One local single experiences some of the best their city has to offer on three blind dates. Our singles may spend three perfect days out on the town, but there can only be one love match. Who will be picked for a second date?

Chefs recreate each other’s signature dish, but they can only determine what the dish is using their senses of taste, touch and smell. When the masks come off, the heat is on, with each chef attempting to cook their opponent’s creation.
The latest news and weather from the WBAL-TV News Team.

In the 1980s, a serial killer buried a woman and three girls in the woods of New Hampshire. One of those girls is still unidentified. WMUR joins the investigators who promise they won’t give up until her name is restored.

ALF and his friends portray an amusing fight against injustice in a jazzed-up version of the classic tale, "Robin Hood", which is considered one of the best in English folklore.
ALF and his friends showcase the magic of true love, a silly battle of good vs evil, and a strangely funny twist in a gender-reversed version of "Sleeping Beauty".
ALF and his friends give a glass-shattering twist to the classic, "Cinderella", by bringing rock 'n' roll, an absent-minded father, and a different kind of fairy godmother into the picture.
Ichabod Crane works with a newspaper, and seems to have solved the mystery of the headless horseman in ALF's version of "The Legend of Sleepy Hollow."
Jack uses magical beans to revive his mother's motel business and ends up finding love in an Alfred Hitchcock version of "Jack and the Beanstalk."
Staggering under failures, the Aladdin brothers wind up in a desert amid a tour and stumble upon a magic lamp that houses a genie in a modern retelling of a popular middle-eastern folk tale.
ALF and his friends present Rapunzel as a long-haired rap-singing beauty with vision-correcting tears in an amusing version of the classic fairytale.
ALF and his friends turn "Rumpelstiltskin" into a modern-day work of detective fiction wherein the protagonist seeks an investigator's help to find out the name of a mystical creature.
In a strangely entertaining version of "The Princess and the Pea", ALF and his friends present the story of a prince who finds love while pursuing comedy as a career.
John Henry becomes an extraordinary chef pitted against a cooking machine in ALF's entertaining version of the popular American folklore.
In an entertaining version of "The Three Little Pigs", ALF and his friends stick to the central plot of young piggies trying to build the best kind of houses.
ALF goes down an elevator shaft instead of a rabbit hole, and enters a magical place to find all kinds of weirdos in his version of "Alice in Wonderland."
ALF and his friends add their own twist to "Peter Pan", the story of a boy who lives in a magical land, never grows up, and befriends three children of a family in the real world.
ALF and his friends present their revamped version of the German classic, "Hansel and Gretel", wherein a brother-sister duo must save themselves from a dreadful witch.
With little help, ALF must take on a powerful witch after he winds up in the land of Oz in an entertaining version of "The Wizard of Oz."
In a retelling of "The Elves and the Shoemaker", a mediator shows up to make things right when a poor guy becomes greedy and exploitative toward some happy helpers.
ALF and his friends give the classic tale, "The Emperor's New Clothes", a hilarious makeover wherein a clothing freak emperor gets duped in the name of fashion.
Goldie Locks does not realize what she is getting herself into by using someone else's house for her enjoyment in ALF'ss version of "Goldie Locks and the Three Bears."
ALF and his friends present their entertaining version of "Little Red Riding Hood", a 17th-century European classic tale about an unsuspecting little girl who faces a scary predator.
ALF and his friends take the rivalry between Snow White and the evil queen to another level in an exciting version of the classic tale.
An Indiana Jones-like character wishes to help King Midas with the cursed touch, but there are people who don't want that to happen in ALF's amusing version of the classic tale.

ALF decides to have some fun while a nervous Mrs. Ochmonek (Liz Sheridan) baby-sits Brian (Benji Gregory).
When Lucky the cat disappears, everyone blames ALF. Stars Max Wright, Anne Schedeen.
ALF calls the president to address his concerns about nuclear weapons. Stars Max Wright, Anne Schedeen.
ALF takes a job selling cosmetics over the phone. Stars Max Wright, Anne Schedeen.

Willie (Max Wright) helps homesick ALF arrange a trip to Melmac.
ALF has a crush on Lynn, so he makes a music video to impress her.

Cassandra forms an unlikely friendship with Val and Agnes when they find out they’re being cheated on by the same man. Then, Cassandra is deceived again by a man who leaves her pregnant with Iris. Iris grows up helping her mother until Cassandra meets and marries Oliver, whom she explains to Iris as the man guaranteed by certain signs. Years later, Iris experiences these signs with her best friend, Ali.

Ali quits the Philippine Military Academy, disobeying his father's wishes. Cast out from his home, Ali turns to Iris for help. Ali and Iris's friendship develops into something more as Iris helps Ali pursue his dreams.

Bianca accepts Percy's job offer in Davao. Roman challenges Carlos to prove himself after learning Gabriel boosted Laban's sales. Bianca and Gabriel cross paths again.

Tiago, meanwhile, eliminates one of his accomplices after his plan to sabotage the elections failed.

Teaming up with hostile rival officers, he uncovers a deadly treasonous plot threatening the highest reaches of the dynasty.

programmes.t: The Tooth and the Nail [English Sub]
programmes.d: In Seoul, a soon after acquiring independence from Japanese occupation, two men met and there came the sound of six shots firing. The police arrests Nam Do-jin, the wealthiest man as a suspect for the murder of a driver named Choi Seung-man. However, all they could find was a burnt body, blood spots, and chopped off fingers. As the trial goes on, it becomes more obvious that the murder had been meticulously planned out and carried out.

After 10 years in the prison on behalf of his boss, Soo-hyuk is released, but the boss doubts his loyalty. When Soo-hyuk visits his long-abandoned girlfriend, he finds out that he, now, is a father of young girl. He wants to cut ties with the gang, but the boss is not ready to release him, and hires a notorious killer. The killer takes the daughter as hostage, and Soo-hyuk decides to take revenge in a way that he's best at; violence.

Ichiro Inuyashiki is a boring office worker who looks like an old man. Even after building them a new home, his family is nothing but ungrateful. One day, Inuyashiki is diagnosed with terminal cancer. Out on a walk to clear his head, a UFO crashes into him, and his body is rebuilt into a deadly robot. He steps in to stop a group of kids from torturing a homeless man when he is knocked unconscious.

Reborn a robot, Inuyashiki finds meaning by saving others. Meanwhile, high school student Hiro Shishigami has also been reborn a robot. Shishigami has no regard for anybody aside from his best friend and his family, and uses his robot powers to kill indiscriminately. Contrary to Inuyashiki, he feels alive when he is taking the lives of others. What happens when these two meet?

Shishigami is rattled to see Inuyashiki stand up from a blow that should have killed him before flying away. Seeing that, Inuyashiki knows that Shishigami has a robot body just like himself. After this meeting, Inuyashiki studies his abilities, and uses them to save others. Meanwhile, Shishigami confronts a group of delinquents who have been tormenting his best friend Naoyuki Ando.

Kaito takes a break from thieving to go on his class ski trip, but when his teacher holds a couples-only masquerade ski tournament, he finds himself in a tug-of-war between the witchy Akako and childhood friend Aoko!

Kaito and Aoko are on a luxury train with the Queen of Ingram, her son, and the Principality of Ingram's Crystal Mother, a huge topaz that may contain the Pandora jewel. The queen has the real jewel cleverly hidden, though, making it a challenge for Kaito/Kid to find it before the train reaches Osaka. On top of that, he's got competition, as there's a Snake on the train!

programmes.t: Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow [English Dub]
programmes.d: Naruto and his team are sent on a mission to guard Yukie Fujikaze, a popular actress starring in the hit movie "The Adventures of Princess Gale."

Eggman takes Chris hostage after tricking Knuckles and Chris into giving him all six Chaos Emeralds discovered. Eggman and Sonic face off once more as Sonic seeks to save Chris and prevent Eggman from obtaining the final Emerald.

When Big the Cat and Froggy discover a Chaos Emerald, a strange blue liquid takes over Froggy's body and runs away with the Chaos Emerald. Meanwhile, Lindsey offers Cream with another Chaos Emerald that she had obtained from a jeweler.

Knuckles recalls how Chaos destroyed the Master Emerald. Suspecting that Chaos is controlling Froggy, the gang decide to head their own ways in search of rescuing Froggy and recovering the Chaos Emerald.

Lupin is in Monaco to race his new toy in the Monaco Grand Prix. Or so he thought. Lupin ends up losing both his money and race car in a fixed poker game at the casino. Then, Fujiko tells Lupin about a fixed race, suggesting that Lupin should enter it to turn the tables on the man who cheated him, while also stealing the enormous betting takes. Who will be laughing at the finish line?

A rare bottle of Bordeaux, commissioned by Napoleon for his beloved wife, Josephine, is to be given to the President of the United States as a Christmas present. Lupin and his gang decide to steal the wine while it's being transported over the Atlantic, but Inspector Zenigata stands in their way. Who will be celebrating come Christmas?

Furuichi is called back from a resort on a tropical island where he was vacationing with his family to go to the public pool with Oga. At the pool, Furuichi runs into a nasty upperclassmen he knew from middle school, and it's not just him, but Nene and the other Red Tails that are in trouble! Will Furuichi, "the strategist" finally make his move?!

The Great Demon Lord decides to send Baby Beel some summer homework on a whim. The gang helps Baby Beel do the homework as best they can, but if they mess up how to use the items in the kit, all of humanity is doomed! Will they actually be able to turn it in on time and in one piece?

Baby Beel comes down with a fever, and Oga's link to him and his never-ending shocking comes to an end. Hilda and Baby Beel disappear, and when Oga goes looking for them he finds Baby Beel stuck on Tojo's back! The battle with the top of the Ishiyama TKKH is here!

Ichiro Inuyashiki is a boring office worker who looks like an old man. Even after building them a new home, his family is nothing but ungrateful. One day, Inuyashiki is diagnosed with terminal cancer. Out on a walk to clear his head, a UFO crashes into him, and his body is rebuilt into a deadly robot. He steps in to stop a group of kids from torturing a homeless man when he is knocked unconscious.

Reborn a robot, Inuyashiki finds meaning by saving others. Meanwhile, high school student Hiro Shishigami has also been reborn a robot. Shishigami has no regard for anybody aside from his best friend and his family, and uses his robot powers to kill indiscriminately. Contrary to Inuyashiki, he feels alive when he is taking the lives of others. What happens when these two meet?

Shishigami is rattled to see Inuyashiki stand up from a blow that should have killed him before flying away. Seeing that, Inuyashiki knows that Shishigami has a robot body just like himself. After this meeting, Inuyashiki studies his abilities, and uses them to save others. Meanwhile, Shishigami confronts a group of delinquents who have been tormenting his best friend Naoyuki Ando.

Kaito takes a break from thieving to go on his class ski trip, but when his teacher holds a couples-only masquerade ski tournament, he finds himself in a tug-of-war between the witchy Akako and childhood friend Aoko!

Kaito and Aoko are on a luxury train with the Queen of Ingram, her son, and the Principality of Ingram's Crystal Mother, a huge topaz that may contain the Pandora jewel. The queen has the real jewel cleverly hidden, though, making it a challenge for Kaito/Kid to find it before the train reaches Osaka. On top of that, he's got competition, as there's a Snake on the train!

When a princess with a priceless jewel comes to town, Inspector Nakamori is sidelined by a detective from her country who shoots first and... shoots again later, until his quarry is killed. Naturally, his target is Kid the Phantom Thief!
Tokyo is suddenly hit by a massive bombing. Two young men who call themselves “Sphinx” start an epic game involving the whole of Japan.
Tokyo is suddenly hit by a massive bombing. Two young men who call themselves “Sphinx” start an epic game involving the whole of Japan.
Adele, Panda and the rest set a trap to lure Onizuka Hideo out, but to no avail.
Onizuka Hideo wants Ke Qiang to find out the whereabouts of "The Vigilante".
Yinxi escorts socialite Gina to Australia for an auction, Yinchen tags along. Gina sells her necklace at a high price to Mr and Mrs Yue Feihong.

Unable to find Yinxi, Yinchen makes a police report. Ruixiang notices that someone is tailing him and injures himself accidentally. At the hospital, Ruixiang runs into Yinchen, who is still trying to look for Yinxi.
It's the day of Sylvia's disciplinary hearing; she braces herself to come clean with the board.
It's the start of Malcolm's fall and the rise of Madelyn as news of his plagiarism breaks.
With Sylvia's help, Philip finds out more about David and Juliet's close relationship.
Adam and Beth try to escape from the clutches of the Colonel's men.
The children have their final showdown with the Colonel to see who will prevail.
Junzhe and Shang Xue make up in the fireflies' garden. They find Yuze's uncle but disagree over why Yuze is missing. Shang Xue gets a video call from Yuze, proving that she is alive.
Shang Xue moves into Junzhe's place. She figures out he is Sherrinford and pieces the clues together, including the suspicious wall in her house.
Ke Xuan finds herself tied to bed, bruised and scarred; she seeks help from Hao Jie's psychiatrist.
Ke Xuan discovers Angela's secret, faints during an argument, and wakes up to Angela dead.
Inspector Mak begins to amass information from the Madame, trouble afflicts the House.
Inspector Mak gathers all the information to pick out the mole that has been hiding all this time.
The spy's identity is discovered, but Fung Lan can't find the strength to make the right decision.
Fung Lan has to make the right decision now that the search for the spy intensifies.
The murders have been resolved.
The children have their final showdown with the Colonel to see who will prevail.
Yi-jung is waiting outside for Eun-jae, excited to see her -- until he listens in on her phone conversation; from her words, it sounds like a call to a boyfriend.

Three middle-aged men meet every day in the dog park while their Shiba Inus play together. It's strictly doggie business, not friendship. Then, one day, a mystery regarding Ataru's love life drives them to get nosy about each other's personal lives.
Jun-pyo begs for Jan Di to advise him not to get married.
Jun-pyo tells Jan Di that he'll protect her, but to Jun-pyo's surprise, she says that she does not want to be cosseted or taken care of.
Perhaps feeling it's time to expose one truth, Mr. Jung leads Jun-hee to the unknown patient's bedside; at the sight of her father, Jun-hee breaks down.
Jun-pyo asks Yumi to make the lunchbox once more, confirming that Yumi had taken credit for her lunch.
Just being rich isn't enough to endure the teen oppression at Shinhwa -- loners are often marked as targets by the bored über-clique called F4.
A wicked rumor is spread on the Internet that a second-year student at Shinhwa High School is pregnant.
Not too eager to watch Jan Di dancing with one of his best friends, Jun Pyo exits the ballroom and ends up taking out his frustrations by the poolside.
Making a rash choice, Jan Di tells her mother she has to go somewhere and runs off, heading toward Namsan Tower.
Jan Di's bike is set ablaze while she is attacked with water balloons and blasted with a fire extinguisher.
Jonathan y Mark rescatan a las víctimas atrapadas en un automóvil, gracias a un perro de gran ayuda.
Un hombre cuyo hijo murió en Vietnam se entera de que tiene un nieto Americano Asiático.
El presentador de un programa infantil tiene una personalidad de televisión de buen corazón.
Otro ángel está molesto porque le han asignado a Jonatán la tarea de buscar pareja para su viuda.
Parejas que pasan en discusiones se van de viaje para aprender qué es lo que los unió.

La tarea de Jonathan y Mark es mostrarle al escritor de una columna que todavía hay algo bueno por ahí.
Jonathan y Mark se hacen pasar por sacerdotes para reabrir una iglesia abandonada como refugio.
Wally es un vagabundo y un titiritero callejero cuyo cariño y bondad lo han convertido en un ángel.
Un pianista en problemas apuros intenta reanudar su vida después de un infarto.
Las estudiantes de secundaria esperan obtener las fechas que desean para el baile.

The Inquisitor roams through time weeding out life's wastrels and deleting the worthless.
Rimmer is taken prisoner inside his own mind and ends up being stripped and humiliated.
After an encounter at a viral research centre, Rimmer puts the crew in quarantine.
The boys from the Dwarf meet their evil doppelgangers, hell bent on destruction.
The crew discover an abandoned space ship, complete with a gigantic sea monster.
In pursuit of the stolen Red Dwarf, Lister and Co are attacked by scantily-clad Psirens.
A malfunctioning guidance beam drags the Dwarfers to a deserted space station.
Kryten contracts a deadly computer virus, and the crew are forced to enter his mindscape.
Lister gets a horrifying proposal from the chief of the offensively ugly GELF tribe.
Trapped aboard a disintegrating ship, Rimmer abandons his crewmates.
The crew are alarmed to receive an SOS call from themselves fifteen years into the future.
Lister's search for an Indian takeaway brings him to Dallas, 1963.
Rimmer's alter ego, Ace, arrives on Starbug fatally wounded with one dying request.
The Dwarfers encounter a real, live human woman who's attractive and nice.
The crew go on a journey of personal discovery when their generators fail.
Lister is missing Rimmer, at least until Kryten steps in to help.
In a hope to educate the crew Kochansky transports them to Pride and Prejudice World.
Lister is impregnated with a virus and he tries to talk his way out of the problem.
The crew finally discover who stole Red Dwarf and why.
The nanobots have not only re-created Red Dwarf, they have also brought back the old crew.
Rimmer plans to move up the career ladder with help from a 'sexual magnetism virus'.
The Dwarfers face two years in the brig for crimes against the Space Corps.
Lister joins a battle-hardened convict army, trained to go on suicide missions.
Kryten, who has been reprogrammed, starts his own pay TV station for the prisoners.
Lister and Rimmer are forced to take on the guards in a basketball game.
Pete the Sparrow is devolved into a Tyrannosaurus Rex by a time-wand.
The Dwarfers are now on probation and are trying their hardest to behave.
Nine years on and the Red Dwarf crew are older but still none the wiser.
Rimmer's replacement, Katerina, is determined to guide Lister back to his home planet.
Knowing they are destined to die, the Dwarfers head to a mysterious address to plead for life.
Rimmer receives an SOS Distress Call from his all-conquering brother, Howard.
On Father's Day, Rimmer points out Lister has been a lousy father to himself.
Marooned in Britain in 23 AD, the Dwarfers need an 8 volt battery to get home.
Lister loses Rimmer in a game of poker to a group of Biologically Engineered Life Forms.
Lister gets himself in a love triangle with Snack Dispensers 23 and 34.

The crew encounters a group of escaped Peacekeeper prisoners including a Nebari, a Scarran and a female Hynerian.
A dangerous situation forces the crew to make a tough decision.

An unlikely source betrays the crew while trying to stop Scorpius' master plan.
The crew must overcome a difficult challenge or face being torn apart; Crichton is haunted by visions of love and death.

Crichton falls under the control of the mysterious and dangerous allure and control of Commandant Grayza.
D'Argo and Sikozu develop a plan to run into the Peacekeepers' ship with Elack, but success requires Crichton getting closer to Grayza.
The crew faces a lava-filled cave and a mercenary squad after an emergency landing.
The crew reunites at Moya, where Crichton discovers that Aeryn is suffering from heatstroke and is being cared for by Scorpius, who is seeking asylum at Moya.
Crichton correctly predicts a wormhole's appearance near Moya, but simultaneously a giant space plant captures the Leviathan.
Crichton and Chiana get stuck in a video game where they encounter strange and twisted versions of their friends.
When a gang of bounty hunters overtakes Moya, Crichton must team with a dubious ally.

An alien doctor poisons the Moya's crew with deadly mollusks.
An interdimensional being believes that Crichton's wormhole knowledge threatens the universe.
After accidentally returning to Earth, Crichton discovers he is in 1985, and he has altered the timeline, causing his father to be scheduled to fly on the doomed shuttle Challenger.
The aliens meet an amazed and apprehensive public; Crichton tries to readjust to life on Earth.
Chiana purchases an abused slave girl from a passing trading ship.
Scorpius takes Crichton, D'Argo and Rygel to an advanced training camp where students learn mental discipline.
The women of Moya stumble upon a secret meeting that will change the future of the Uncharted Territories.
The crew travels through a wormhole to Earth in 1985; when Crichton discovers that his father is about to fly the doomed ride with the Challenger, he tries to turn back time.
Crichton and Scorpius travel through a wormhole to a mixed-up version of Moya in search of abducted Aeryn.
Moya's crew traces Aeryn to a freighter at a scarecrow border station; Noranti releases a deadly, contagious virus to keep the vessel in dock.
Moya's crew travels to a heavily guarded Scarran base where Scorpius is being tortured for critical wormhole information.
After thwarting Crichton's escape plan, Scorpius denies he is a Scarran spy.
With their Crystherium stores low, the Scarrans must travel to Earth through a wormhole as those flowers grow there; with Pilot's help, Crichton tries to collapse the wormhole leading back to Earth.
Astronaut John Crichton is accidentally hurled across a universe and thrust into the middle of a space battle after his ship is swallowed by a wormhole.
Giant space-cockroaches invade the ship, infest the corridors and clog the vents, causing a rise in temperature which endangers Aeryn.
A sensual alien seduces men to obtain a weapon of mass destruction; Crichton experiences mental flashes of the future.
For trade with the Tavleks, Rygel (John Eccleston, Jonathan Hardy) takes a crystal essential to Moya's survival.
Crichton and a female Peacekeeper Tech, left behind by Captain Crais, join forces to save Moya when a race of scavengers attacks.
Crichton must free D'Argo from the influence of a thought-altering plant.
Moya crash-lands on a planet to avoid being traced by the Peacekeepers; Crichton soon realizes that he has become an alien to the inhabitants.
When an evil sorcerer engineers a deadly contest between Crichton and Crais, Zhaan must rouse a dark power within herself to rescue Crichton.
When the crew seeks out a genetic scientist who can provide them with charts to their homeworlds, the scientist secretly injects Aeryn with Pilot's DNA.
After D'Argo suffers a mishap during a maintenance check on Moya, he is tormented by flashbacks; the ship strikes out at the crew.
While gathering data to re-create a wormhole, Crichton and Aeryn are confronted by wolflike bounty hunters in search of Moya's crew.
An invisible net controlled by Zenetan pirates captures Crichton and Aeryn's transport pod and threatens to snare the Moya as well.
When Zhaan tries to aid in curing Tahleen's madness, Tahleen betrays her and reveals Zhaan's dark side.
Crichton stumbles upon the planet of Acquara, an Earth-like paradise where no mechanical devices seem to function after landing.
Mental cleansing changes a Peacekeeper, who once tormented Rygel, into a servile being; with Ben Browder, Gigi Edgley and Tiriel Mora.
Crichton travels through a wormhole that greatly affects Earth, where the entire crew is subjected to intense testing and imprisonment.

programmes.d: Discover how a Soviet Intelligence officer avoided WWIII.
Discover how and why several brilliant scientists divulged the secrets of the atomic bomb.
America and Europe in 1491, and why America was discovered and not the other way around.
The true legacy of Columbus is biological, and it created one world out of two.
More than 2000 years ago the Maya built gigantic cities in the middle of the jungle of Central America. They were brilliant inventors and set standards in writing, mathematics and astronomy.
The Aztecs: Within a very short time they created a huge empire, whose metropolis was a perfectly organized floating garden city on the Mexican plateau.
The Incas appear out of nowhere and within a few decades their empire develops into the largest empire in the world at the time.
To many, Columbus is the man who discovered America. Yet, there had been others before him. This is their story!

It’s the birthplace of democracy, where great thinkers forged the beginnings of scientific reasoning, where theatre was turned into mass entertainment, and where the Olympic Games began. programmes.t: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Romans Changed the World
programmes.d: The Romans created one of the greatest empires in history, built with the help of an incredible army of professional legionnaires and a well-oiled political machinery. At its height, a few hundred men ruled over a fifth of mankind and an area stretching from Britain to Syria and from Gibraltar to the Euphrates. They undertook some of the most ambitious building projects of their time: endless roads, gigantic bridges and imposing aqueducts formed a complex infrastructure and left a lasting legacy

programmes.t: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Vikings Changed the World

Master shipbuilders, they forged vast networks of commerce stretching from Europe to Asia and even reached the shores of America centuries before Columbus.
